| Reporting Reference Date | Enter the date to which the register information relates for annual competent authority reporting, in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Financial Entity Legal Name | Enter the full legal name of the DORA-regulated financial entity that uses or is responsible for the ICT third-party arrangement. |
| Financial Entity Identifier Type | Enter the identifier type for the financial entity; allowed values: LEI, National Registration Number, VAT Number, Other. |
| Financial Entity Identifier | Enter the corresponding identifier value for the financial entity, such as the 20-character LEI or national registration number. |
| Financial Entity Type | Enter the DORA financial entity category; allowed values include Credit Institution, Payment Institution, Electronic Money Institution, Investment Firm, Crypto-Asset Service Provider, Central Securities Depository, Central Counterparty, Trading Venue, Trade Repository, AIFM, Management Company, Insurance Undertaking, Reinsurance Undertaking, IORP, Insurance Intermediary, Credit Rating Agency, Statutory Auditor or Audit Firm, Administrator of Critical Benchmarks, Crowdfunding Service Provider, Securitisation Repository, Other. |
| Country of Authorisation | Enter the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the Member State or jurisdiction where the financial entity is authorised or registered. |
| Branch or Entity Using the Service | Enter the name of the branch, subsidiary, business unit, or legal entity consuming the ICT service; use 'Group-wide' if applicable. |
| Intra-Group Arrangement | State whether the ICT service provider is part of the same group; allowed values: Yes, No. |
| ICT Third-Party Service Provider Legal Name | Enter the full legal name of the direct contractual ICT third-party service provider. |
| ICT Third-Party Service Provider Identifier Type | Enter the identifier type for the direct provider; allowed values: LEI, National Registration Number, VAT Number, DUNS, Other, Not Available. |
| ICT Third-Party Service Provider Identifier | Enter the provider identifier corresponding to the selected identifier type; enter 'Not Available' only where no identifier exists and retain evidence. |
| ICT Third-Party Service Provider Group Name | Enter the ultimate parent or provider group name if the provider belongs to a corporate group; otherwise enter 'Not Applicable'. |
| Provider Registered Address Country | Enter the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the provider's registered legal address. |
| Provider Head Office Country | Enter the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the provider's head office or principal place of business. |
| Provider Contact Point | Enter the operational or account management contact for the arrangement, including name or team mailbox and telephone where available. |
| Contract or Arrangement Reference | Enter the internal contract ID, purchase order, framework agreement reference, or arrangement reference used to locate the executed agreement. |
| Contract Signature Date | Enter the date the contract or arrangement was signed, in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Contract Start Date | Enter the effective start date of the ICT service provision, in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Contract End Date | Enter the current contractual end or expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter 'Open-ended' only where there is no fixed end date. |
| Contract Renewal Type | Enter the renewal mechanism; allowed values: Fixed Term, Automatic Renewal, Rolling Notice, Open-ended, Other. |
| Notice Period for Termination | Enter the contractual termination notice period as a number and unit, for example '90 calendar days' or '6 months'. |
| ICT Service Category | Enter the primary ICT service category; allowed values: Cloud Computing, Data Centre or Hosting, Network or Connectivity, Software or SaaS, Application Development or Maintenance, IT Support or Managed Service, Cybersecurity Service, Data or Analytics Service, Payment or Transaction Processing ICT, Hardware or Infrastructure, Other ICT Service. |
| ICT Service Description | Describe the ICT service provided in clear business terms, including the platform, application, infrastructure, or managed service covered by the arrangement. |
| Cloud Service Model | If cloud is used, enter the model; allowed values: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, BPaaS, Other Cloud, Not Applicable. |
| Deployment Model | Enter the deployment or hosting model; allowed values: Public Cloud, Private Cloud, Hybrid Cloud, Community Cloud, On-Premise Hosted by Provider, Provider Data Centre, Not Applicable, Other. |
| Supports Critical or Important Function | State whether the arrangement supports a critical or important function under DORA; allowed values: Yes, No, To Be Assessed. |
| Critical or Important Function Name | If applicable, enter the name of the critical or important function supported; otherwise enter 'Not Applicable'. |
| Function Identifier | Enter the internal identifier for the supported function from the firm's function taxonomy, business service map, or criticality register; enter 'Not Applicable' if none. |
| Reason Function Is Critical or Important | Summarise the rationale for criticality, such as material financial impact, customer harm, regulatory obligation, market integrity, operational continuity, or inability to substitute quickly. |
| Business Area or Process Supported | Enter the business line, process, product, or operational capability relying on the ICT service. |
| Substitutability of Provider | Assess ease of replacing the provider; allowed values: High, Medium, Low, Not Assessed, with High meaning readily substitutable and Low meaning difficult to substitute. |
| Impact of Provider Failure | Enter the assessed impact on the financial entity if the provider fails or service is disrupted; allowed values: Low, Medium, High, Severe. |
| Data Processed by Provider | Describe the main data types processed, stored, transmitted, or accessed by the provider, such as customer data, transaction data, authentication logs, employee data, market data, or no production data. |
| Personal Data Processed | State whether personal data is processed under the arrangement; allowed values: Yes, No, Unknown. |
| Sensitive or Confidential Data Processed | State whether sensitive, confidential, regulated, or business-critical data is processed; allowed values: Yes, No, Unknown. |
| Data Location Countries | Enter all countries where relevant data may be located using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes separated by semicolons; use 'Unknown' only where remediation is open. |
| Data Storage Location Countries | Enter all countries where data is stored at rest using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes separated by semicolons; enter 'Not Applicable' if no data is stored. |
| Data Processing Location Countries | Enter all countries where data processing occurs using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes separated by semicolons. |
| Access Location Countries | Enter countries from which provider personnel or subcontractors may access systems or data using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes separated by semicolons. |
| Service Delivery Location Countries | Enter countries from which the ICT service is materially delivered, operated, supported, or administered using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes separated by semicolons. |
| Estimated Annual Contract Value | Enter the estimated annual value of the ICT arrangement as a numeric amount excluding tax, using the currency in the Currency column. |
| Currency | Enter the ISO 4217 currency code for the annual contract value, for example EUR, GBP, USD. |
| Outsourcing Classification | Classify the arrangement under the firm's outsourcing and third-party policy; allowed values: ICT Third-Party Service, ICT Outsourcing, Non-Outsourcing ICT Service, Intra-Group ICT Service, To Be Classified. |
| Materiality Assessment Reference | Enter the reference or link to the materiality or criticality assessment supporting the classification; use a document ID, GRC record ID, or repository link. |
| ICT Risk Assessment Reference | Enter the reference to the ICT third-party risk assessment, including inherent and residual risk assessment record where available. |
| Due Diligence Completion Date | Enter the date pre-contract or periodic due diligence was completed, in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Pre-Contract Risk Assessment Outcome | Enter the outcome of the pre-contract assessment; allowed values: Approved, Approved with Conditions, Rejected, Waiver Approved, Not Applicable, In Progress. |
| Approval Body | Enter the governance forum, committee, accountable executive, or delegated authority that approved the arrangement. |
| Approval Date | Enter the approval date for the arrangement or latest renewal, in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Contractual Audit and Access Rights Included | State whether the contract includes audit, information, inspection, and access rights for the financial entity; allowed values: Yes, No, Partial, Not Applicable. |
| Regulator Access Rights Included | State whether the contract includes access, audit, and information rights for competent authorities and resolution authorities where applicable; allowed values: Yes, No, Partial, Not Applicable. |
| Data Return and Deletion Rights Included | State whether the contract includes rights and procedures for data return, transfer, deletion, and confirmation at exit; allowed values: Yes, No, Partial, Not Applicable. |
| Business Continuity Requirements Included | State whether the contract includes resilience, backup, business continuity, disaster recovery, and testing requirements; allowed values: Yes, No, Partial, Not Applicable. |
| Exit Strategy Required | State whether a documented exit strategy is required for this arrangement; allowed values: Yes, No. |
| Exit Strategy Reference | Enter the document or GRC reference for the exit strategy or exit plan; enter 'Not Applicable' if no exit strategy is required. |
| Exit Plan Tested | State whether the exit plan has been tested or exercised; allowed values: Yes, No, Partially, Not Due, Not Applicable. |
| Last Exit Plan Test Date | Enter the most recent exit plan test date in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter 'Not Applicable' if no test is required or due. |
| Service Level Agreements Defined | State whether measurable SLAs, KPIs, KRIs, or service performance measures are contractually defined; allowed values: Yes, No, Partial, Not Applicable. |
| Key SLAs or KPIs | List the key service measures relevant to resilience, availability, support, incident response, recovery, or performance; separate multiple measures with semicolons. |
| Last Performance Review Date | Enter the date of the most recent supplier performance, service, or contract review, in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Performance Status | Enter the current performance status; allowed values: Green, Amber, Red, Not Reviewed. |
| Incident Notification Obligations Included | State whether the contract requires timely notification of ICT incidents, cyber incidents, service disruptions, and relevant subcontractor incidents; allowed values: Yes, No, Partial, Not Applicable. |
| Last ICT Incident Involving Provider Date | Enter the most recent ICT incident date involving this provider and arrangement in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter 'None' if no incident has occurred in the reporting period. |
| Provider Supports Time-Critical Services | State whether the service supports a time-critical business service or process; allowed values: Yes, No, To Be Assessed. |
| Recovery Time Objective | Enter the agreed or required maximum tolerable time to restore the service, using a duration such as '4 hours' or '2 business days'; enter 'Not Defined' if absent. |
| Recovery Point Objective | Enter the agreed or required maximum tolerable data loss, using a duration such as '15 minutes' or '24 hours'; enter 'Not Defined' if absent. |
| Subcontracting Permitted | State whether the provider is contractually permitted to use subcontractors for the ICT service; allowed values: Yes, No, With Prior Approval, With Notification, Unknown. |
| Subcontractor Register Available | State whether an up-to-date list of subcontractors supporting the service is held or accessible; allowed values: Yes, No, Not Applicable. |
| Material Subcontractor Legal Name | Enter the legal name of any material subcontractor supporting the ICT service; where multiple material subcontractors exist, create additional rows or use a controlled linked subcontractor sheet. |
| Material Subcontractor Identifier Type | Enter the identifier type for the material subcontractor; allowed values: LEI, National Registration Number, VAT Number, DUNS, Other, Not Available, Not Applicable. |
| Material Subcontractor Identifier | Enter the identifier value for the material subcontractor, or 'Not Applicable' where there is no material subcontractor. |
| Material Subcontractor Service Description | Describe the service or activity performed by the material subcontractor, especially if it supports a critical or important function. |
| Subcontractor Country | Enter the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the material subcontractor's registered address or main service delivery location. |
| Subcontractor Supports Critical or Important Function | State whether the subcontractor supports a critical or important function; allowed values: Yes, No, To Be Assessed, Not Applicable. |
| Subcontractor Data Location Countries | Enter countries where the material subcontractor stores, processes, or accesses relevant data using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes separated by semicolons; enter 'Not Applicable' if no data access. |
| Subcontractor Approval Status | Enter the financial entity's approval status for the subcontractor; allowed values: Approved, Approved with Conditions, Not Approved, Notification Received, Not Required, Not Applicable. |
| Chain Outsourcing Dependency Notes | Record any relevant dependency chain, fourth-party risk, or concentration issue arising from subcontracting, including reliance on cloud regions, support centres, or common infrastructure. |
| Concentration Risk Assessment Reference | Enter the reference to the concentration risk assessment considering provider, group, technology, geography, service category, and critical function dependencies. |
| Concentration Risk Rating | Enter the assessed concentration risk rating; allowed values: Low, Medium, High, Severe, Not Assessed. |
| Most Recent Register Review Date | Enter the date this register entry was last reviewed and validated by the responsible owner, in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Record Owner | Enter the accountable internal owner for the register entry, normally the service owner, contract owner, or third-party relationship owner, including role or team. |
| Record Status | Enter the lifecycle status of the register entry; allowed values: Draft, Active, Pending Approval, Terminated, Expired, Archived. |
| Evidence Repository Link | Enter the link or repository path to supporting evidence such as contract, risk assessment, due diligence, approvals, SLA reports, subcontractor notifications, and exit plan. |
| Comments | Enter concise additional notes, open issues, remediation actions, assumptions, or reporting caveats relevant to this register entry. |

### Maintenance

Owned by the Third-Party Risk Management or ICT Vendor Management function with accountable input from service owners, procurement, legal, ICT risk, and operational resilience. Updated at onboarding, contract change, renewal, termination, material subcontractor change, incident or risk reassessment, and formally reconciled at least quarterly and before annual competent authority reporting using the contract management system, procurement/vendor master, GRC/TPRM platform, CMDB/service catalogue, risk assessments, SLA reports, and evidence repository.

### Column Guidance

| Column | What to enter |
|---|---|
| Record ID | Enter a unique identifier for this due diligence record, using the organisation’s naming convention, e.g. TPP-DD-YYYY-NNN. |
| Due Diligence Status | Enter the current status using one of: Not Started, In Progress, Awaiting Provider Evidence, Awaiting Internal Review, Completed, Rejected, Expired, Superseded. |
| Requesting Business Owner | Enter the name, role, and business unit of the internal owner requesting the prospective ICT service. |
| ICT Third-Party Provider Legal Name | Enter the full legal name of the prospective ICT third-party provider as it would appear in the contract. |
| Provider Unique Identifier | Enter a reliable identifier for the provider, such as company registration number, LEI, VAT/tax ID, or internal vendor master ID; specify the identifier type. |
| Provider Country of Incorporation | Enter the country where the provider is legally incorporated, using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code where possible, e.g. DE, FR, IE. |
| Proposed ICT Service Description | Describe the ICT service to be procured, including core activities, technology type, hosting model, managed service scope, software/platform name, and whether the service is cloud, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, outsourcing, data centre, telecoms, or other ICT service. |
| Procurement / Sourcing Reference | Enter the procurement, sourcing, RFP, tender, or vendor onboarding reference number linked to this due diligence activity. |
| Supported Function / Process | Identify the internal function, process, product, service, or system that the ICT third-party service will support. |
| Critical or Important Function Assessment | Record whether the proposed service supports a critical or important function using one of: Yes, No, To Be Determined; include the basis for the determination in brief. |
| Criticality Assessment Reference | Enter the reference or link to the formal criticality/materiality assessment, business impact analysis, or service classification record supporting the conclusion. |
| Proposed Contract Start Date | Enter the planned contract start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Due Diligence Initiation Date | Enter the date due diligence began in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Due Diligence Completion Date | Enter the date due diligence was completed in YYYY-MM-DD format; leave blank until completed. |
| Due Diligence Valid Until | Enter the expiry date of this due diligence assessment in YYYY-MM-DD format, based on the organisation’s reassessment frequency or material change rules. |
| Inherent ICT Third-Party Risk Rating | Enter the risk rating before controls and mitigations using the organisation’s scale, e.g. Low, Medium, High, Critical, based on service criticality, data sensitivity, dependency, connectivity, and operational impact. |
| Provider Suitability Conclusion | Summarise whether the provider is considered suitable for the proposed service using one of: Suitable, Suitable with Conditions, Not Suitable, Pending Evidence. |
| Business Reputation Assessment | Record the outcome of checks on business reputation, integrity, sanctions/adverse media, legal disputes, regulatory actions, market standing, and relevant past performance; include result as Pass, Conditional Pass, Fail, or Pending. |
| Financial Standing Assessment | Record the outcome of financial viability checks, such as credit rating, audited accounts, profitability, solvency, insurance, going-concern indicators, or parent support; include result as Pass, Conditional Pass, Fail, or Pending. |
| Technical Capability Assessment | Record the assessment of the provider’s technical expertise, architecture, service maturity, technology stack, integration capability, scalability, and ability to deliver the proposed ICT service; include result as Pass, Conditional Pass, Fail, or Pending. |
| Operational Capacity Assessment | Record the assessment of the provider’s human resources, staffing model, support coverage, service management capability, incident response capability, operational resilience, and ability to meet expected volumes and service levels; include result as Pass, Conditional Pass, Fail, or Pending. |
| Information Security and Resilience Assessment | Record the assessment of security and ICT resilience controls, including access management, encryption, vulnerability management, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, incident notification, testing, and recovery objectives; include result as Pass, Conditional Pass, Fail, or Pending. |
| Data Protection / Confidentiality Assessment | Record the assessment of personal data, confidential information, bank secrecy or regulated data handling, including data categories, lawful transfer basis, confidentiality controls, data retention, deletion, and privacy/security obligations; include result as Pass, Conditional Pass, Fail, or Pending. |
| Regulatory Compliance Assessment | Record whether the provider can support applicable DORA, financial sector regulatory, supervisory access, audit, reporting, outsourcing, data location, and contractual requirements; include result as Pass, Conditional Pass, Fail, or Pending. |
| Audit / Certification Evidence Reviewed | List the evidence reviewed, such as ISO 27001 certificate, SOC 1/SOC 2 report, CSA STAR, penetration test summary, resilience test evidence, BCP/DR test results, policies, financial statements, or independent assurance reports; include document names and dates. |
| Subcontracting / ICT Supply Chain Assessment | Record whether subcontractors will support material parts of the service, identify known material subcontractors, their countries, service roles, chain complexity, approval rights, notification commitments, and associated risks; include result as Acceptable, Acceptable with Conditions, Not Acceptable, or Pending. |
| Locations of Service Delivery and Data Processing | Enter the countries and, where known, regions/cities where services will be delivered, systems hosted, support performed, and data stored, processed, or accessed; use ISO country codes where possible. |
| Concentration Risk Assessment | Record the assessment of ICT concentration risk, including existing reliance on the same provider/group, same technology, same region, same subcontractor, or non-substitutable service; include result as Low, Medium, High, Critical. |
| Conflict of Interest Assessment | Record whether actual or potential conflicts of interest were identified involving the provider, group entities, subcontractors, decision-makers, or related parties; use None Identified, Identified - Mitigated, Identified - Not Mitigated, or Pending. |
| Exit Feasibility Assessment | Record whether the organisation can exit or transition the service without undue disruption, including data portability, replacement options, transition support, termination assistance, and estimated exit complexity; include result as Feasible, Feasible with Conditions, Not Feasible, or Pending. |
| Risk Findings Summary | Summarise the material due diligence findings, gaps, risks, red flags, and dependencies that must be considered before contracting. |
| Required Remediation / Conditions Before Contracting | List mandatory actions, mitigations, approvals, contractual protections, evidence requests, or risk acceptances required before contract signature; state owner and due date where known. |
| Residual Risk Rating | Enter the expected risk rating after planned mitigations and contractual conditions using the organisation’s scale, e.g. Low, Medium, High, Critical. |
| Approval Decision | Enter the formal decision using one of: Approved to Contract, Approved with Conditions, Rejected, Deferred Pending Evidence, Risk Accepted by Exception. |
| Approver Name and Role | Enter the name and role of the accountable approver, such as Head of Procurement, ICT Risk Owner, CISO, DPO, Business Owner, Outsourcing Committee Chair, or Management Body delegate. |
| Approval Date | Enter the date the approval decision was made in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Contracting Restrictions / Mandatory Clauses | Record any required contractual clauses or restrictions arising from due diligence, including audit/access rights, security requirements, incident notification, subcontracting approval, data location, termination rights, exit support, service levels, reporting, and supervisory access. |
| Evidence Repository Link | Enter the controlled repository path, GRC system link, procurement folder, or document management URL where supporting evidence and approvals are stored. |
| Next Review Trigger | Enter the event or timing that will require reassessment, such as Prior to Contract Signature, Annual Review, Material Change, New Subcontractor, Scope Change, Criticality Change, Incident, Renewal, or Due Diligence Expiry. |
| Comments | Enter any additional relevant notes that are not captured elsewhere; do not use this field for mandatory assessment outcomes. |

### Maintenance

Owned by the ICT Third-Party Risk Management function with input from Procurement, Legal, Information Security, Data Protection, Compliance, and the requesting Business Owner. Updated before contract signature for every prospective ICT third-party provider, refreshed on material change or expiry, and sourced from the GRC/TPRM platform, procurement system, contract repository, vendor master, and controlled evidence repository.
