 11.1. The document owner shall identify external documented information necessary for the planning and operation of the FMMS.

 11.2. External documented information may include:

 - Statutory and regulatory requirements.
 - Building codes and standards.
 - Customer or landlord requirements.
 - Manufacturer manuals and maintenance instructions.
 - Supplier, contractor and service provider documents.
 - Service level agreements and contract schedules.
 - Asset certificates and test reports.
 - Permits, licences and regulatory approvals.
 - Technical drawings, specifications and commissioning documentation.
 - Insurance, safety or environmental requirements relevant to facilities.

 11.3. Required external documented information shall be entered into the External Document Register or approved equivalent.

 | External Document Field | Requirement |
 |---|---|
 | Title/description | Name of external document |
 | Source/issuer | Regulator, supplier, customer, manufacturer, landlord, contractor, etc. |
 | Version/date | Current known version or issue date |
 | Owner | Internal role accountable for monitoring and use |
 | Applicability | Facility, asset, service, contract or process affected |
 | Access location | Repository, URL, system or physical location |
 | Review/verification frequency | How often currency is confirmed |
 | Usage restrictions | Licence, confidentiality or contractual limits |
 | Status | Current, superseded, under review, withdrawn |

 11.4. The document owner shall verify that external documented information is current, relevant and authorised before use.

 11.5. Where external documents are controlled by third parties, the internal owner shall define how changes are monitored, such as subscription alerts, supplier notifications, regulatory monitoring, contract review meetings or periodic checks.

 11.6. External documented information that is no longer current or applicable shall be withdrawn from use or marked superseded.

12. **Retain FMMS records as evidence of conformity**

 12.1. Records generated by FMMS processes shall be retained as evidence that processes have been performed as planned and requirements have been met.

 12.2. FMMS records shall be legible, identifiable, traceable to the relevant activity and protected from unauthorised alteration.

 12.3. Records shall be retained in accordance with the approved records retention schedule and applicable statutory, regulatory, contractual and business requirements.

 12.4. Records shall not be destroyed before the expiry of the retention period unless approved by Legal and the Facilities Management System Manager.

 12.5. Records subject to audit, investigation, dispute, claim, legal hold or regulatory inquiry shall be preserved until released by the authorised function.

 12.6. Typical FMMS records include:

 | Record Type | Minimum Retention Requirement | Typical Owner |
 |---|---:|---|
 | FMMS internal audit reports | [X years] | Facilities Management System Manager |
 | Management review records | [X years] | Facilities Management System Manager |
 | Maintenance completion records | [X years] or asset lifecycle requirement | Maintenance Manager |
 | Statutory inspection certificates | As legally required, minimum [X years] | Compliance Manager / Asset Owner |
 | Contractor induction records | [X years] after contract or site access end | Contract Manager |
 | Incident and nonconformity records | [X years] | FM Operations Manager |
 | Corrective action records | [X years] after closure | Facilities Management System Manager |
 | Asset commissioning records | Asset life plus [X years] | Asset Manager |
 | Risk assessments and method statements | [X years] or until superseded plus retention period | Health & Safety / Contract Manager |
 | Service performance reports | [X years] | Contract Manager / FM Performance Manager |

13. **Dispose of documented information**

 13.1. Documented information shall be disposed of only after:

 - Retention requirements have been met.
 - No legal hold, investigation, claim, dispute or audit requirement applies.
 - Disposal is authorised by the document owner or records owner.
 - Disposal method is appropriate to classification and media.

 13.2. Disposal methods shall include:

 | Media Type | Disposal Method |
 |---|---|
 | Public or Internal hard copy | Recycling or secure disposal as appropriate |
 | Confidential or Restricted hard copy | Cross-cut shredding or approved secure destruction |
 | Electronic records | Deletion using approved system controls, subject to backup/retention rules |
 | Removable media | Secure wiping or physical destruction |
 | Contractor-held FMMS records | Return, certified destruction or managed retention per contract |

 13.3. Disposal of Confidential or Restricted FMMS documented information shall be recorded, including date, description, authorising person and disposal method.

 13.4. Disposal certificates or logs shall be retained where secure destruction services are used.

14. **Monitor document control effectiveness**

 14.1. The Facilities Management System Manager shall monitor effectiveness of document control arrangements through planned checks, audits, user feedback and management review inputs.

 14.2. Monitoring activities may include:

 - Review of overdue document reviews.
 - Sampling of documents for approval evidence and metadata completeness.
 - Verification that obsolete documents are not available at points of use.
 - Review of controlled hard copy locations.
 - Verification of access permissions for sensitive FM documents.
 - Sampling of records for legibility, traceability and retention compliance.
 - Review of external document currency.
 - Review of document-related nonconformities and corrective actions.

 14.3. Nonconformities identified through document control monitoring shall be recorded and managed through the FMMS corrective action process.

## Roles & RACI

The following RACI matrix defines responsibilities for document control activities.

| Activity | Top Management | FM Director | Facilities Management System Manager | Document Owner / Process Owner | Document Controller | FM Users | Legal / Compliance / H&S / InfoSec | Supplier / Contractor |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Define FMMS document control requirements | A | C | R | C | C | I | C | I |
| Determine need for documented information | I | A | C | R | C | C | C | C |
| Create or update controlled documents | I | C | C | R | C | C | C | C |
| Assign document ID and metadata | I | I | A | C | R | I | I | I |
| Review documents for adequacy | I | C | R | R | C | C | C | C |
| Approve FMMS policy documents | A/R | C | C | C | I | I | C | I |
| Approve FMMS procedures | I | A/R | C | R | I | I | C | I |
| Publish approved controlled documents | I | I | A | C | R | I | I | I |
| Maintain FMMS Document Register | I | I | A | C | R | I | I | I |
| Control access to documented information | I | A | R | C | R | I | C | I |
| Manage document change requests | I | C | A | R | R | C | C | C |
| Withdraw obsolete documents | I | I | A | C | R | I | I | I |
| Control external documented information | I | C | A | R | C | I | C | C |
| Retain FMMS records | I | A | C | R | C | R | C | C |
| Dispose of records after retention | I | A | C | R | R | I | C | C |
| Monitor document control effectiveness | I | C | A/R | C | R | C | C | I |

RACI key:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| R | Responsible for performing the activity |
| A | Accountable for ensuring the activity is completed and approved |
| C | Consulted before or during the activity |
| I | Informed of outcome or decision |

Specific role responsibilities are as follows:

| Role | Responsibilities |
|---|---|
| Top Management | Ensures the FMMS has adequate resources and approves high-level FMMS documented information where required. |
| FM Director | Provides executive accountability for FM document control and approves designated FMMS procedures, plans and major changes. |
| Facilities Management System Manager | Owns this procedure, ensures ISO 41001:2018 requirements are implemented, monitors effectiveness and reports issues through FMMS governance. |
| Document Owner / Process Owner | Creates, reviews, maintains and ensures accuracy of assigned documented information; ensures records are created and retained. |
| Document Controller | Administers document registers, numbering, version control, publication, archival, withdrawal and controlled copy management. |
| FM Users | Use current approved documents, create required records, protect documented information and report errors or improvement opportunities. |
| Legal / Compliance / H&S / InfoSec | Provides specialist review where documentation involves statutory obligations, safety, security, privacy, contractual or regulatory requirements. |
| Supplier / Contractor | Provides required external documented information, uses current approved FM documents and maintains records as required by contract. |

## Records & Outputs

The following records and outputs shall be created or maintained as evidence of effective document control.

| Record / Output | Description | Owner | Storage Location | Minimum Retention |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FMMS Document Register | Master list of controlled FMMS documents, including ID, owner, version, status, review date and location. | Document Controller | [Document Management System] | Current plus [X years] |
| External Document Register | Register of external documented information necessary for FMMS planning and operation. | Facilities Management System Manager | [Document Management System] | Current plus [X years] |
| Document Change Request | Request and assessment record for document changes. | Document Owner | [Document Management System] | [X years] |
| Approval Evidence | Workflow record, signed approval page, email or equivalent approval evidence. | Document Controller | [Document Management System] | Life of document plus [X years] |
| Revision History | Record of changes made to controlled documents. | Document Owner | Within document and/or register | Life of document |
| Obsolete Document Archive | Superseded versions retained for historical, audit, legal or knowledge purposes. | Document Controller | [Archive Location] | Per retention schedule |
| Controlled Hard Copy Register | Register of authorised printed controlled documents and locations. | Document Controller | [Document Management System] | Current plus [X years] |
| Records Retention Schedule | Defined retention periods and disposal requirements for FMMS records. | Facilities Management System Manager | [Document Management System] | Current plus [X years] |
| Disposal Log / Destruction Certificate | Evidence of authorised disposal of records or obsolete documents. | Document Controller / Records Owner | [Document Management System] | [X years] |
| Document Review Log | Evidence of periodic review, confirmation or update. | Document Controller | [Document Management System] | [X years] |
| Access Permission Review Evidence | Record of periodic access verification for restricted FMMS documentation. | Facilities Management System Manager | [Document Management System] | [X years] |
| Document Control Audit Results | Results of internal checks or audits of document control effectiveness. | Facilities Management System Manager | [Audit Repository] | [X years] |

The FMMS Document Register shall contain, at minimum, the following fields:

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| Document ID | Unique document identifier |
| Document title | Approved title |
| Document type | Policy, procedure, work instruction, plan, form, register, record, etc. |
| Owner | Accountable document owner |
| Version | Current approved version |
| Status | Draft, current, under review, superseded, withdrawn |
| Classification | Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted or approved equivalent |
| Approval authority | Role/person approving current version |
| Effective date | Date document becomes active |
| Review date | Next scheduled review date |
| Storage location | Authorised repository or physical location |
| Related documents | Linked procedures, forms, records or external documents |
| Retention requirement | Retention period where applicable |

## Exceptions & Escalation

Exceptions to this procedure shall be limited, justified, approved and recorded.

An exception may be requested where:

- Immediate operational use of a document is required before normal approval is completed.
- Emergency response or statutory compliance requires temporary issue of instructions.
- A third-party system or contractual arrangement prevents full application of standard controls.
- A legacy document cannot immediately be migrated to the approved repository.
- A hard copy document must be used due to operational or safety needs.
- Retention or disposal requirements conflict and require specialist interpretation.
- Access to documented information is restricted due to legal, security or confidentiality constraints.

Exception requests shall include:

| Field | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Exception requester | Name, role and department |
| Document or record affected | Title, ID, version or description |
| Reason for exception | Business, operational, legal, safety or technical justification |
| Risk assessment | Impact on availability, suitability, integrity, confidentiality or compliance |
| Compensating controls | Temporary controls to reduce risk |
| Duration | Start date and end date or review date |
| Required approvals | Facilities Management System Manager and relevant accountable owner |
| Closure action | Action required to return to standard control |

Approval requirements for exceptions are:

| Exception Type | Minimum Approval |
|---|---|
| Emergency temporary document issue | Facilities Management System Manager and relevant Process Owner |
| Use of obsolete document for defined purpose | Facilities Management System Manager and Document Owner |
| Extended retention beyond schedule | Document Owner and Legal/Compliance |
| Early disposal before normal retention expiry | Document Owner, Legal/Compliance and FM Director |
| Restricted access due to security sensitivity | Document Owner and Information Security or Security Manager |
| External document used without full verification | Process Owner and Facilities Management System Manager |
| Prolonged non-use of approved repository | FM Director and Facilities Management System Manager |

Escalation shall occur where:

- Required documented information is unavailable for critical FM operations.
- Obsolete documentation is found in active use.
- Statutory or regulatory records are missing, incomplete or inaccurate.
- Confidential or Restricted FM documentation is disclosed without authorisation.
- Required approvals cannot be obtained within required timeframes.
- External documented information is found to be outdated or unreliable.
- A document control failure creates operational, legal, safety, security, contractual or customer impact.
- Repeated document control nonconformities are identified.

Escalation path:

| Issue Severity | Examples | Escalation Path | Target Response |
|---|---|---|---|
| Low | Minor metadata error, formatting issue, non-critical typo | Document Owner or Document Controller | Within [5 business days] |
| Medium | Overdue review, unclear instruction, missing approval evidence, incorrect version in non-critical area | Facilities Management System Manager and Process Owner | Within [2 business days] |
| High | Obsolete document in active use, missing compliance record, incorrect operational control | FM Director, Facilities Management System Manager, relevant function lead | Within [1 business day] |
| Critical | Safety, legal, regulatory, security, customer or service continuity impact | Top Management, FM Director, Legal/Compliance, H&S, InfoSec as applicable | Immediate escalation |

Exceptions and escalations shall be recorded and, where appropriate, managed through the FMMS nonconformity and corrective action process.

## Review

This procedure shall be reviewed at least annually or sooner where one or more of the following occur:

- Changes to ISO 41001:2018 or applicable FMMS requirements.
- Significant changes to FMMS scope, processes, organisational structure or operating model.
- Introduction or replacement of document management, CAFM, IWMS or records management systems.
- Changes to statutory, regulatory, contractual or customer requirements affecting FM documented information.
- Internal or external audit findings relating to documented information.
- Repeated document control nonconformities or user issues.
- Significant incident, service failure, compliance breach or security event involving documented information.
- Management review decision requiring update.
- Changes to retention, privacy, security or legal requirements.
- Identification of improvement opportunities.

The Facilities Management System Manager is responsible for coordinating the review. The review shall verify whether this procedure remains:

- Suitable for the organisation’s FMMS context and scope.
- Adequate to meet ISO 41001:2018 requirements.
- Effective in ensuring availability, suitability and protection of documented information.
- Aligned with related governance, records, information security, legal and operational procedures.
- Understood and applied by relevant FM personnel and service providers.

Review evidence shall be retained in the Document Review Log or equivalent approved record. Updates shall follow the change control steps defined in this procedure.

### Column Guidance

| Column | What to enter |
|---|---|
| Work Order ID | Enter the unique work order or maintenance record number from the CMMS or work order system; format should match the source system identifier. |
| Record Type | Select one value: Planned Maintenance, Reactive Maintenance, Corrective Maintenance, Preventive Maintenance, Predictive Maintenance, Inspection, Statutory Maintenance, Emergency Repair. |
| Maintenance Category | Enter the maintenance discipline or service type, e.g. HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Safety, Lifts, Fabric, Security, Cleaning Equipment, Grounds, Utilities. |
| Request/Trigger Source | Enter what initiated the work, e.g. maintenance plan, inspection finding, occupant request, alarm, breakdown, statutory inspection, audit finding, condition monitoring. |
| Request Date | Enter the date the request or trigger was logged in format YYYY-MM-DD. |
| Requested By | Enter the name, role, department, or system that raised the request. |
| Facility/Site | Enter the facility, site, campus, or property name where the work is required. |
| Building/Floor/Area | Enter the specific building, floor, room, zone, plantroom, external area, or location identifier. |
| Asset ID | Enter the asset register ID/tag number for the maintained asset; use N/A only where the work is not asset-specific. |
| Asset Description | Enter a short description of the asset or maintainable item, including make/model where useful. |
| Asset Criticality | Select one value based on the asset register: Critical, High, Medium, Low, N/A. |
| Issue/Task Description | Describe the defect, task, inspection, maintenance activity, or service requirement clearly enough for the assignee to perform the work. |
| ISO 41001 Clause Reference | Enter the relevant management system reference; for this template use ISO 41001:2018 Cl. 8.1 unless the organisation maps additional internal controls. |
| Service Level/Response Requirement | Enter the applicable SLA, response time, completion target, or maintenance frequency, e.g. 4-hour response, complete within 5 working days, monthly PM. |
| Priority | Select one value: Emergency, Urgent, High, Medium, Low, Routine. |
| Operational Risk/Safety Impact | State the operational, health and safety, environmental, business continuity, security, or occupant impact; enter None if not applicable. |
| Statutory/Regulatory Requirement | State any legal, code, permit, inspection, warranty, or compliance obligation linked to the work; enter N/A if none. |
| Planned Due Date | Enter the required completion date in format YYYY-MM-DD, based on the maintenance plan, SLA, risk priority, or statutory requirement. |
| Scheduled Start Date/Time | Enter the planned start date and time in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM using local time; leave blank until scheduled. |
| Assigned Team/Technician | Enter the internal maintenance team, technician, engineer, or responsible role assigned to complete the work. |
| External Contractor | Enter the approved contractor company and contact name if outsourced; enter N/A if completed internally. |
| Permit/Access Required | Select one value: Yes, No; use Yes where permits, isolations, confined space, hot works, roof access, security access, or occupant coordination are required. |
| Permit/Access Reference | Enter the permit number, access approval, isolation certificate, method statement approval, or visitor/access reference; enter N/A if not required. |
| Work Method/Procedure Reference | Enter the SOP, maintenance instruction, risk assessment, method statement, manufacturer manual, checklist, or job plan reference used. |
| Materials/Parts Required | List key parts, consumables, tools, or materials required, including part numbers and quantities where known; enter None if not required. |
| Work Status | Select one value: New, Triaged, Scheduled, In Progress, On Hold, Awaiting Parts, Awaiting Contractor, Completed Pending Verification, Closed, Cancelled. |
| Actual Start Date/Time | Enter the actual start date and time in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM using local time; leave blank until work starts. |
| Actual Completion Date/Time | Enter the actual physical completion date and time in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM using local time; leave blank until work is completed. |
| Downtime Duration | Enter asset or service downtime duration in hours to one decimal place, e.g. 2.5; enter 0 if no downtime occurred. |
| Work Performed/Completion Notes | Record what was actually done, inspections/tests completed, parts replaced, readings taken, and any deviations from the planned method. |
| Root Cause | For reactive/corrective work, enter the known or suspected cause of failure; enter N/A for routine planned maintenance or where not determined. |
| Follow-up Action Required | Select one value: Yes, No; use Yes where further maintenance, investigation, replacement, monitoring, risk control, or capital work is needed. |
| Follow-up Action Owner | Enter the person or role responsible for the follow-up action; enter N/A if no follow-up is required. |
| Follow-up Due Date | Enter the due date for follow-up action in format YYYY-MM-DD; enter N/A if no follow-up is required. |
| Completion Verified By | Enter the name and role of the person who verified the work was completed and acceptable, e.g. supervisor, facilities manager, requester, authorised engineer. |
| Verification Date | Enter the date completion was verified in format YYYY-MM-DD. |
| Quality/Acceptance Result | Select one value: Accepted, Accepted with Follow-up, Rework Required, Failed Test, Not Verified. |
| Evidence/Attachment Reference | Enter links or references to supporting evidence such as photos, inspection sheets, test certificates, service reports, permits, invoices, or calibration records. |
| Cost | Enter the total cost of labour, parts, and contractor charges in the organisation's reporting currency, e.g. 1250.00 GBP; enter 0.00 if not tracked. |
| Customer/Occupant Impact | Describe any impact to users, occupants, visitors, service delivery, access, comfort, safety, or operations; enter None if no impact. |
| Customer/Occupant Communication | Record communication issued or required, including notice reference, date/time, audience, and channel; enter N/A if not required. |
| Closed Date | Enter the date the work order was administratively closed in format YYYY-MM-DD after verification and evidence upload. |
| Closed By | Enter the name and role of the person closing the record in the CMMS or work order system. |
| Retention/Archive Reference | Enter the document repository path, archive ID, or retention classification for the completed record and evidence. |

### Maintenance

Owned by the Facilities/Maintenance Manager or CMMS Administrator, with each work order updated in real time from request through closure and reviewed at least monthly for overdue, recurring, statutory, and high-risk items. Source data should be drawn from the CMMS/work order system, asset register, planned preventive maintenance schedule, service desk, contractor reports, permits, and completed inspection/test evidence.

ISO41-019.title: Asset Register / Equipment Inventory
ISO41-019.content:
## Asset Register / Equipment Inventory (XLSX template)

_Editable template — add your own rows. The example row(s) below are placeholders to replace._

| Asset ID | Asset Tag / Barcode | Asset Name | Asset Description | Asset Category | Asset Type | Location / Site | Building / Floor / Room / Area | Functional Area Served | Asset Owner | Responsible FM Team / Custodian | Manufacturer | Model | Serial Number | Quantity | Unit of Measure | Acquisition Date | Commissioning Date | Purchase Order / Contract Reference | Supplier / Installer | Original Cost | Currency | Replacement Value | Expected Useful Life Years | Lifecycle Stage | Current Condition Rating | Condition Assessment Date | Criticality Rating | Criticality Rationale | Operational Impact if Failed | Statutory / Regulatory Requirement | Applicable Compliance / Inspection Requirement | Warranty Expiry Date | Maintenance Strategy | Preventive Maintenance Frequency | Last Maintenance Date | Next Maintenance Due Date | Maintenance Procedure / SOP Reference | Asset Documentation Location | Energy / Utility Dependency | Safety / Environmental Risk | Business Continuity Dependency | Spare Parts Required | Obsolescence Risk | Planned Renewal / Replacement Date | Disposal / Decommissioning Date | Asset Status | Record Last Updated Date | Record Updated By | Comments / Notes |

### Column Guidance

| Column | What to enter |
|---|---|
| Asset ID | Enter the unique internal identifier for the asset; use a consistent format such as AST-000001 and do not reuse retired IDs. |
| Asset Tag / Barcode | Enter the physical tag, QR code, barcode, or RFID reference attached to the asset; enter Not tagged if no tag exists. |
| Asset Name | Enter the commonly used asset name, such as Chiller 1, Fire Alarm Panel, Lift 2, or Generator A. |
| Asset Description | Enter a brief description sufficient to identify the asset, including capacity or key characteristics where relevant. |
| Asset Category | Select the broad category of asset; allowed values: Building Fabric, Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire & Life Safety, Security, ICT / AV, Furniture & Fixtures, Grounds / External, Fleet / Mobile Equipment, Other. |
| Asset Type | Enter the specific asset type, such as AHU, boiler, UPS, access control panel, roof membrane, pump, lift, desk, vehicle, or other defined type. |
| Location / Site | Enter the site or facility where the asset is located using the organisation's approved site name or code. |
| Building / Floor / Room / Area | Enter the precise physical location using building, floor, room, zone, plantroom, or area reference. |
| Functional Area Served | Enter the business, operational, or facilities area supported by the asset, such as Data Centre, Reception, Production Hall, Office Floor 3, or Whole Building. |
| Asset Owner | Enter the role or department accountable for the asset and lifecycle decisions, not an individual unless required by procedure. |
| Responsible FM Team / Custodian | Enter the team or contractor responsible for day-to-day control, operation, maintenance coordination, or inspection of the asset. |
| Manufacturer | Enter the manufacturer or brand name exactly as shown on the asset nameplate or documentation. |
| Model | Enter the manufacturer's model number or product reference; enter Not available if unknown. |
| Serial Number | Enter the manufacturer's serial number; enter Not available if not present. |
| Quantity | Enter the number of identical units represented by this register line; normally 1 for uniquely managed assets. |
| Unit of Measure | Enter the unit of measure for the quantity; allowed values: Each, Set, Metre, Square metre, Cubic metre, Lot, Other. |
| Acquisition Date | Enter the date the asset was purchased or obtained in YYYY-MM-DD format; leave blank only if not known. |
| Commissioning Date | Enter the date the asset was commissioned, placed into service, or accepted for operational use in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Purchase Order / Contract Reference | Enter the purchase order, contract, project, or capital expenditure reference that evidences acquisition or installation. |
| Supplier / Installer | Enter the supplier, installer, contractor, or integrator responsible for supplying or installing the asset. |
| Original Cost | Enter the original acquisition or installed cost excluding tax where possible; numeric value only, no currency symbol. |
| Currency | Enter the three-letter ISO currency code for cost values, such as USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, or ZAR. |
| Replacement Value | Enter the current estimated replacement cost for lifecycle planning; numeric value only, no currency symbol. |
| Expected Useful Life Years | Enter the expected useful service life in whole years based on manufacturer guidance, asset policy, or lifecycle plan. |
| Lifecycle Stage | Select the current lifecycle stage; allowed values: Planned, Acquired, Installed, Commissioned, In Service, Under Maintenance, Refurbishment, Renewal Planned, Decommissioned, Disposed. |
| Current Condition Rating | Select the latest condition rating; allowed values: 1-Excellent, 2-Good, 3-Fair, 4-Poor, 5-Failed / Unserviceable, Not assessed. |
| Condition Assessment Date | Enter the date the current condition rating was assessed in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Criticality Rating | Select the asset criticality rating based on the organisation's criticality method; allowed values: Critical, High, Medium, Low. |
| Criticality Rationale | Enter the reason for the criticality rating, considering safety, statutory compliance, service delivery, business continuity, customer impact, environmental impact, or cost impact. |
| Operational Impact if Failed | Describe the expected impact if the asset fails, including affected services, downtime, safety impact, compliance impact, or operational disruption. |
| Statutory / Regulatory Requirement | Enter Yes or No to indicate whether the asset is subject to legal, statutory, regulatory, licence, or mandatory inspection requirements. |
| Applicable Compliance / Inspection Requirement | If statutory or compliance requirements apply, enter the regulation, code, inspection type, certificate, or compliance obligation; otherwise enter Not applicable. |
| Warranty Expiry Date | Enter the warranty end date in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter Not applicable if no warranty applies. |
| Maintenance Strategy | Select the approved maintenance approach; allowed values: Reactive, Preventive, Predictive, Condition-Based, Statutory Inspection, Run-to-Failure, Outsourced Specialist, Other. |
| Preventive Maintenance Frequency | Enter the planned maintenance interval; use a clear format such as Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, 6-Monthly, Annual, 5-Yearly, Condition-based, or Not applicable. |
| Last Maintenance Date | Enter the date of the most recent completed maintenance, service, inspection, or test in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Next Maintenance Due Date | Enter the next planned maintenance, inspection, service, or test due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Maintenance Procedure / SOP Reference | Enter the approved maintenance instruction, SOP, method statement, task plan, statutory inspection checklist, or work order template reference. |
| Asset Documentation Location | Enter the controlled location or system link for manuals, drawings, certificates, warranties, O&M files, test records, or as-built documentation. |
| Energy / Utility Dependency | Enter key utilities or services required for the asset to operate; allowed examples: Electricity, Gas, Water, Steam, Compressed Air, Network, Fuel, None, Other. |
| Safety / Environmental Risk | Select the inherent safety or environmental risk associated with asset failure or operation; allowed values: High, Medium, Low, None identified. |
| Business Continuity Dependency | Enter Yes or No to indicate whether the asset supports a business continuity, emergency response, resilience, or mission-critical process. |
| Spare Parts Required | Enter key critical spares, consumables, or replacement parts required to maintain service, or enter Not identified. |
| Obsolescence Risk | Select the risk that the asset will become unsupported, uneconomic, or technologically obsolete; allowed values: High, Medium, Low, Not assessed. |
| Planned Renewal / Replacement Date | Enter the planned renewal, major refurbishment, or replacement date in YYYY-MM-DD format based on lifecycle planning. |
| Disposal / Decommissioning Date | Enter the actual or planned decommissioning or disposal date in YYYY-MM-DD format; leave blank while the asset remains in service unless planned. |
| Asset Status | Select the current register status; allowed values: Active, Inactive, Out of Service, Awaiting Repair, Under Replacement, Decommissioned, Disposed, Missing. |
| Record Last Updated Date | Enter the date this register entry was last reviewed or updated in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Record Updated By | Enter the name, role, or user ID of the person who last updated or verified the register entry. |
| Comments / Notes | Enter any additional relevant information needed to support facilities management planning, auditability, or lifecycle decisions; keep concise and factual. |

### Maintenance

The Facilities Asset Manager owns this template, with updates made whenever assets are acquired, moved, modified, maintained, reclassified, renewed, decommissioned, or disposed, and with a formal review at least annually. The register should draw from the CAFM/IWMS or CMMS, finance fixed asset records, procurement records, O&M documentation, statutory inspection records, and site condition surveys.

field_guidance.Unit of Measure: Enter the unit of measure for the quantity; allowed values: Each, Set, Metre, Square metre, Cubic metre, Lot, Other.
field_guidance.Acquisition Date: Enter the date the asset was purchased or obtained in YYYY-MM-DD format; leave blank only if not known.
field_guidance.Commissioning Date: Enter the date the asset was commissioned, placed into service, or accepted for operational use in YYYY-MM-DD format.
field_guidance.Purchase Order / Contract Reference: Enter the purchase order, contract, project, or capital expenditure reference that evidences acquisition or installation.
field_guidance.Supplier / Installer: Enter the supplier, installer, contractor, or integrator responsible for supplying or installing the asset.
field_guidance.Original Cost: Enter the original acquisition or installed cost excluding tax where possible; numeric value only, no currency symbol.
field_guidance.Currency: Enter the three-letter ISO currency code for cost values, such as USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, or ZAR.
field_guidance.Replacement Value: Enter the current estimated replacement cost for lifecycle planning; numeric value only, no currency symbol.
field_guidance.Expected Useful Life Years: Enter the expected useful service life in whole years based on manufacturer guidance, asset policy, or lifecycle plan.
field_guidance.Lifecycle Stage: Select the current lifecycle stage; allowed values: Planned, Acquired, Installed, Commissioned, In Service, Under Maintenance, Refurbishment, Renewal Planned, Decommissioned, Disposed.
field_guidance.Current Condition Rating: Select the latest condition rating; allowed values: 1-Excellent, 2-Good, 3-Fair, 4-Poor, 5-Failed / Unserviceable, Not assessed.
field_guidance.Condition Assessment Date: Enter the date the current condition rating was assessed in YYYY-MM-DD format.
field_guidance.Criticality Rating: Select the asset criticality rating based on the organisation's criticality method; allowed values: Critical, High, Medium, Low.
field_guidance.Criticality Rationale: Enter the reason for the criticality rating, considering safety, statutory compliance, service delivery, business continuity, customer impact, environmental impact, or cost impact.
field_guidance.Operational Impact if Failed: Describe the expected impact if the asset fails, including affected services, downtime, safety impact, compliance impact, or operational disruption.
field_guidance.Statutory / Regulatory Requirement: Enter Yes or No to indicate whether the asset is subject to legal, statutory, regulatory, licence, or mandatory inspection requirements.
field_guidance.Applicable Compliance / Inspection Requi: If statutory or compliance requirements apply, enter the regulation, code, inspection type, certificate, or compliance obligation; otherwise enter Not applicable.
field_guidance.Warranty Expiry Date: Enter the warranty end date in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter Not applicable if no warranty applies.
field_guidance.Maintenance Strategy: Select the approved maintenance approach; allowed values: Reactive, Preventive, Predictive, Condition-Based, Statutory Inspection, Run-to-Failure, Outsourced Specialist, Other.
field_guidance.Preventive Maintenance Frequency: Enter the planned maintenance interval; use a clear format such as Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, 6-Monthly, Annual, 5-Yearly, Condition-based, or Not applicable.
field_guidance.Last Maintenance Date: Enter the date of the most recent completed maintenance, service, inspection, or test in YYYY-MM-DD format.
field_guidance.Next Maintenance Due Date: Enter the next planned maintenance, inspection, service, or test due date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
field_guidance.Maintenance Procedure / SOP Reference: Enter the approved maintenance instruction, SOP, method statement, task plan, statutory inspection checklist, or work order template reference.
field_guidance.Asset Documentation Location: Enter the controlled location or system link for manuals, drawings, certificates, warranties, O&M files, test records, or as-built documentation.
field_guidance.Energy / Utility Dependency: Enter key utilities or services required for the asset to operate; allowed examples: Electricity, Gas, Water, Steam, Compressed Air, Network, Fuel, None, Other.
field_guidance.Safety / Environmental Risk: Select the inherent safety or environmental risk associated with asset failure or operation; allowed values: High, Medium, Low, None identified.
field_guidance.Business Continuity Dependency: Enter Yes or No to indicate whether the asset supports a business continuity, emergency response, resilience, or mission-critical process.
field_guidance.Spare Parts Required: Enter key critical spares, consumables, or replacement parts required to maintain service, or enter Not identified.
field_guidance.Obsolescence Risk: Select the risk that the asset will become unsupported, uneconomic, or technologically obsolete; allowed values: High, Medium, Low, Not assessed.
field_guidance.Planned Renewal / Replacement Date: Enter the planned renewal, major refurbishment, or replacement date in YYYY-MM-DD format based on lifecycle planning.
field_guidance.Disposal / Decommissioning Date: Enter the actual or planned decommissioning or disposal date in YYYY-MM-DD format; leave blank while the asset remains in service unless planned.
field_guidance.Asset Status: Select the current register status; allowed values: Active, Inactive, Out of Service, Awaiting Repair, Under Replacement, Decommissioned, Disposed, Missing.
field_guidance.Record Last Updated Date: Enter the date this register entry was last reviewed or updated in YYYY-MM-DD format.
field_guidance.Record Updated By: Enter the name, role, or user ID of the person who last updated or verified the register entry.
field_guidance.Comments / Notes: Enter any additional relevant information needed to support facilities management planning, auditability, or lifecycle decisions; keep concise and factual.

### Column Guidance

| Column | What to enter |
|---|---|
| Record ID | Enter a unique identifier for this inspection/test record, e.g. ITR-YYYY-0001. |
| Site/Facility | Enter the name or code of the facility where the inspection/test was performed. |
| Building/Area/Asset Location | Enter the specific building, floor, room, zone, plant room, or external area inspected; use the organisation’s location naming convention. |
| Asset/System/Service Inspected or Tested | Enter the asset, system, infrastructure element, or FM service inspected/tested, e.g. fire alarm system, lift, HVAC unit, water hygiene, emergency lighting. |
| Asset ID/Tag | Enter the asset register ID, tag number, serial number, or system reference; enter N/A only where no asset ID exists. |
| Inspection/Test Type | Enter the type of inspection or test performed, e.g. visual inspection, functional test, statutory examination, compliance inspection, performance test, sampling, calibration check. |
| Statutory/Routine Category | Select one: Statutory, Regulatory, Contractual, Manufacturer Requirement, Internal Routine, Risk-Based, Other. |
| Legal/Regulatory/Other Requirement Reference | Enter the applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, manufacturer, or internal requirement reference driving the inspection/test; enter N/A for purely discretionary checks. |
| ISO 41001 Clause/Process Reference | Enter the relevant ISO 41001 or FM process reference, normally ISO 41001:2018 Cl. 9.1 and any internal procedure/control ID. |
| Inspection/Test Standard or Method | Enter the procedure, checklist, standard, manufacturer instruction, or test method used, including document number and version where applicable. |
| Planned Frequency | Enter the required frequency, e.g. Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, 6-Monthly, Annual, 5-Yearly, Event-Based, Risk-Based. |
| Planned Due Date | Enter the scheduled due date for the inspection/test in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Actual Inspection/Test Date | Enter the date the inspection/test was completed in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Inspection/Test Provider | Enter Internal or the name of the external contractor/competent body that performed the inspection/test. |
| Inspector/Tester Name | Enter the full name of the person who performed the inspection/test. |
| Competence/Certification Reference | Enter the licence, qualification, authorisation, appointment, training record, or competent person certificate reference; enter N/A if not applicable. |
| Instrument/Equipment Used | Enter any test instrument, meter, analyser, gauge, or equipment used, including equipment ID where applicable; enter N/A if no instrument was used. |
| Instrument Calibration Status | Enter Calibrated, Not Required, Out of Calibration, or Unknown; where calibrated, include calibration due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Acceptance Criteria/Pass Requirements | Enter the measurable or observable criteria used to determine pass/fail, including thresholds, limits, tolerances, or checklist requirements. |
| Results/Readings Observed | Enter the actual observed result, reading, measurement, or inspection finding, including units where applicable, e.g. °C, bar, lux, ppm, %, minutes. |
| Result Status | Select one: Pass, Fail, Conditional Pass, Not Tested, Not Applicable. |
| Nonconformity/Defect Description | If the result is Fail or Conditional Pass, describe the defect, nonconformity, unsafe condition, missed requirement, or limitation; enter N/A if none. |
| Risk/Severity Rating | Select the assessed risk or severity using the organisation’s scale, e.g. Low, Medium, High, Critical, or RAG: Green, Amber, Red. |
| Immediate Action Taken | Enter any action taken at the time of inspection/test to make safe, isolate, repair, escalate, or control the issue; enter N/A if none. |
| Corrective/Follow-up Action Required | Enter the action required to correct the defect/nonconformity or improve performance; enter N/A if no follow-up is required. |
| Action Owner | Enter the named role or person responsible for completing the corrective/follow-up action; enter N/A if no action is required. |
| Target Completion Date | Enter the planned completion date for the corrective/follow-up action in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter N/A if no action is required. |
| Actual Completion Date | Enter the actual date the corrective/follow-up action was completed in YYYY-MM-DD format; leave blank until completed or enter N/A if no action is required. |
| Verification/Retest Date | Enter the date the completed action was verified or retested in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter N/A if verification/retest is not required. |
| Verification/Retest Result | Select one: Pass, Fail, Accepted by Risk Assessment, Not Required, Pending. |
| Certificate/Report Reference | Enter the certificate number, inspection report number, work order number, or service report reference generated from the inspection/test. |
| Evidence/File Link | Enter the controlled repository link or file path to the certificate, report, checklist, photos, readings, or signed record. |
| Next Inspection/Test Due Date | Enter the next required due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, calculated from the applicable frequency, statutory interval, risk assessment, or provider recommendation. |
| Record Retention Period | Enter the required retention period for this record, e.g. 3 years, 5 years, life of asset, statutory period, or as defined in the document retention schedule. |
| Reviewed By | Enter the full name or role of the person who reviewed the record for completeness, compliance, and required actions. |
| Review Date | Enter the date the record was reviewed in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Comments | Enter any additional relevant notes, exclusions, access limitations, operational constraints, or cross-references; enter N/A if none. |

### Maintenance

Owned by the Facilities Compliance Manager or FM Compliance Lead and updated after each statutory, regulatory, contractual, risk-based, or routine inspection/test, with periodic review at least monthly for overdue actions and at least annually for template adequacy. Source data should be drawn from the CAFM/CMMS, asset register, statutory compliance register, contractor inspection reports, certificates, work orders, and controlled document repository.

### Column Guidance

| Column | What to enter |
|---|---|
| Record ID | Enter a unique log reference for this record, e.g. EUCL-YYYY-0001. |
| Reporting Period Start | Enter the first day covered by the consumption data in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Reporting Period End | Enter the last day covered by the consumption data in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Facility/Site Name | Enter the official name of the facility, building, site, campus, or asset consuming the utility. |
| Facility/Site ID | Enter the internal asset, property, or facility reference code used by the organisation. |
| Location/Area Covered | Specify the physical scope covered by the record, e.g. whole building, floor, plant room, data centre, car park lighting, tenant area. |
| Utility Type | Select or enter the utility category: Electricity, Natural Gas, Water, District Heating, District Cooling, Fuel Oil, LPG, Diesel, Steam, Wastewater, Other. |
| Meter/Account ID | Enter the meter number, sub-meter ID, invoice account number, or utility supply point identifier used to trace the data. |
| Supplier/Provider | Enter the name of the utility supplier, landlord, network provider, or internal provider supplying the utility. |
| Data Source | State where the figures came from, e.g. utility invoice, smart meter export, BMS, manual meter reading, landlord statement, fuel delivery note, supplier portal. |
| Opening Meter Reading | Enter the opening reading at the start of the period; use numeric values only, or enter N/A if invoice-based consumption is used without readings. |
| Closing Meter Reading | Enter the closing reading at the end of the period; use numeric values only, or enter N/A if invoice-based consumption is used without readings. |
| Reading Unit | Enter the unit shown on the meter or source document, e.g. kWh, m3, litres, gallons, tonnes, MWh. |
| Consumption Quantity | Enter the total consumption for the period as a numeric value after any meter multiplier or conversion has been applied. |
| Consumption Unit | Enter the final reporting unit for consumption, e.g. kWh, MWh, m3, litres, tonnes, kg. |
| Estimated or Actual Data | Enter Actual, Estimated, or Mixed to indicate data reliability for ISO 41001 performance monitoring. |
| Estimation Method | If data is Estimated or Mixed, describe the method used, e.g. prior period average, degree-day adjustment, supplier estimate, pro-rata invoice; enter N/A if Actual. |
| Cost Amount | Enter the total cost for the reporting period as a numeric value excluding tax unless the organisation’s reporting rule requires otherwise. |
| Currency | Enter the ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, AED. |
| Applicable Tariff/Rate | Enter the tariff name or rate applied, including unit rate if available, e.g. Standard electricity tariff 0.18 GBP/kWh; enter N/A if not available. |
| Baseline Consumption | Enter the approved baseline consumption for the same facility, utility, and comparable period as a numeric value in the same Consumption Unit. |
| Baseline Period | Enter the baseline period used for comparison, e.g. 2023-01 to 2023-12 or YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD. |
| Performance Target | Enter the relevant sustainability or FM performance target for this utility, e.g. ≤ 50,000 kWh/month, 5% reduction vs baseline, ≤ 0.20 m3/m2/month. |
| Variance to Target | Enter the absolute variance between actual consumption and the target using the same unit as the target; use positive values for over-target and negative values for under-target, unless otherwise defined internally. |
| Variance to Target % | Enter the percentage variance against target using numeric percentage format, e.g. 4.5%, -3.2%. |
| Normalisation Factor | Enter the factor used to make performance comparable, e.g. floor area m2, occupancy count, production units, heating degree days, cooling degree days; enter N/A if not used. |
| Normalised Consumption | Enter consumption divided or adjusted by the normalisation factor, including the unit in the cell if needed, e.g. 18.4 kWh/m2; enter N/A if not used. |
| Greenhouse Gas Emission Factor | Enter the emission factor applied and its source/year, e.g. 0.207 kgCO2e/kWh DEFRA 2024, or enter N/A where not calculated. |
| Estimated CO2e Emissions | Enter calculated emissions for the period in kgCO2e or tCO2e, clearly using the same unit consistently across the log; enter N/A if not calculated. |
| Renewable/Low-Carbon Share % | Enter the percentage of consumption supplied from renewable or low-carbon sources, e.g. 0%, 35%, 100%; enter N/A if not applicable or not known. |
| Anomaly Identified | Enter Yes or No to indicate whether consumption, cost, emissions, or data quality is outside expected range or requires investigation. |
| Anomaly Description | If Anomaly Identified is Yes, describe the issue, e.g. spike vs baseline, missing data, leak suspected, abnormal night load; enter N/A if No. |
| Corrective/Improvement Action Required | Enter the required action to address poor performance, anomaly, or improvement opportunity; enter N/A if no action is required. |
| Action Owner | Enter the role or named person responsible for completing the action; enter N/A if no action is required. |
| Action Due Date | Enter the action completion due date in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter N/A if no action is required. |
| Action Status | Enter Not Started, In Progress, Complete, Overdue, Deferred, or N/A. |
| Evidence Reference/Link | Enter the document reference, file path, URL, invoice number, meter export filename, dashboard link, or BMS report reference supporting the record. |
| Recorded By | Enter the name or role of the person who entered the record. |
| Date Recorded | Enter the date this log entry was created in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Reviewed By | Enter the name or role of the person who reviewed the entry for completeness, accuracy, and performance relevance. |
| Review Date | Enter the review date in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Review Outcome | Enter Accepted, Accepted with Action, Rejected, or Pending Review, based on the reviewer’s assessment. |

### Maintenance

Owned by the Facilities/Energy Manager with review by the Sustainability or FM Performance Manager; updated at least monthly and after each billing cycle or meter export. Source data should be drawn from utility invoices, smart meters, BMS/EMS platforms, manual meter readings, supplier portals, fuel delivery records, and approved sustainability performance targets/baselines.

ISO41-022.content:

### Column Guidance

| Column | What to enter |
|---|---|
| Record ID | Enter a unique identifier for this competence/training record, e.g. CTR-0001; do not reuse IDs. |
| Employee/Worker ID | Enter the unique HR, contractor, or supplier personnel identifier for the individual; use 'N/A' only where no identifier exists. |
| Name | Enter the individual's full name exactly as recorded in the HR, contractor, or supplier record. |
| Employment Type | Select one value: Employee, Contractor, Agency Worker, Supplier Personnel, Volunteer, Other. |
| Department/Function | Enter the department, team, or function responsible for the person, e.g. Facilities Management, Maintenance, Security, Cleaning, HSE. |
| FM Role/Position | Enter the job title or FM role being assessed, e.g. Facilities Manager, Maintenance Technician, Cleaning Supervisor. |
| Work Location/Site | Enter the site, building, region, or service location where the person performs FM duties. |
| FM Process/Service Area | Enter the FM service or process the competence relates to, e.g. Planned Maintenance, Helpdesk, Asset Management, Cleaning, Security, Space Management, Energy Management. |
| Competence Requirement ID | Enter the unique ID for the competence requirement from the organisation's competence framework, job description, legal register, procedure, or training matrix, e.g. COMP-FM-001. |
| Required Competence/Skill | Describe the specific knowledge, skill, training, qualification, licence, or experience required to perform the FM role or task competently. |
| Competence Category | Select one value: Education, Training, Experience, Qualification, Licence/Certification, Technical Skill, Legal/Regulatory, HSE/Safety, Behavioural/Leadership, System/Process Knowledge. |
| Required Proficiency Level | Enter the required level using the organisation's defined scale, e.g. 1-Awareness, 2-Working Knowledge, 3-Competent to Work Unsupervised, 4-Supervisor/Approver, 5-Expert/Trainer. |
| Requirement Source | Enter the source that establishes the competence requirement, e.g. Job Description, FM Procedure, Legal Requirement, Contract Requirement, Risk Assessment, Manufacturer Requirement, ISO 41001 FMS Requirement, Client Requirement. |
| Mandatory for Role | Select Yes or No to indicate whether the competence is mandatory before the person may perform the role or task. |
| Current Proficiency Level | Enter the person's current assessed level using the same scale as Required Proficiency Level. |
| Competence Evidence Type | Select the main evidence type: Training Record, Certificate, Licence, Qualification, CV/Experience Record, Observation, Interview, Test/Assessment, Work Output Review, Supervisor Attestation, Other. |
| Evidence Reference/Link | Enter the document number, LMS record ID, certificate number, file path, or system link where evidence is stored; do not attach sensitive personal data unless authorised. |
| Competence Assessment Method | Enter how competence was determined, e.g. document review, practical observation, written test, interview, supervisor assessment, probation review, refresher assessment. |
| Assessor Name/Role | Enter the name and role of the competent person, manager, trainer, or assessor who assessed the individual. |
| Assessment Date | Enter the date competence was assessed in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Competence Status | Select one value: Competent, Competent with Supervision, Not Yet Competent, Training Required, Expired, Not Applicable. |
| Competence Gap Description | Where Current Proficiency Level is below Required Proficiency Level or evidence is missing/expired, describe the specific gap; enter 'None' if no gap exists. |
| Training/Development Need | Enter the required training, coaching, supervised work, qualification, refresher, or other action needed to close the competence gap; enter 'None' if not required. |
| Training Course/Activity Title | Enter the title of the delivered or planned training/development activity; enter 'N/A' if no training activity applies. |
| Training Provider | Enter the internal trainer, external provider, awarding body, or platform name that delivered or will deliver the training; enter 'N/A' if not applicable. |
| Training Delivery Method | Select one value: Classroom, E-learning, Toolbox Talk, On-the-job Training, Coaching/Mentoring, Practical Assessment, External Course, Briefing, Self-study, Other, N/A. |
| Training Start Date | Enter the start date of the training/development activity in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter 'N/A' if not applicable. |
| Training Completion Date | Enter the completion date in YYYY-MM-DD format; leave blank only if training is planned or in progress. |
| Training Hours | Enter the duration in hours as a number to one decimal place, e.g. 2.5; enter 0 if not applicable. |
| Attendance/Completion Status | Select one value: Planned, In Progress, Completed, Did Not Attend, Cancelled, Failed, Not Applicable. |
| Certificate/Qualification Reference | Enter certificate number, licence number, qualification ID, or LMS completion reference; enter 'N/A' where no certificate or qualification is issued. |
| Certificate/Competence Expiry Date | Enter expiry or refresher due date in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter 'No Expiry' where the evidence does not expire. |
| Effectiveness Evaluation Method | Enter how the organisation verified that training or action was effective, e.g. post-training test, workplace observation, KPI review, supervisor sign-off, audit result, incident reduction, no evaluation required. |
| Effectiveness Evaluation Result | Select one value: Effective, Partially Effective, Not Effective, Pending, Not Required, and add a brief result statement if needed. |
| Effectiveness Evaluation Date | Enter the date effectiveness was evaluated in YYYY-MM-DD format; leave blank only where evaluation is pending or not required. |
| Next Action Required | Enter the follow-up action required, e.g. refresher training, reassessment, supervised practice, obtain certificate, update role matrix, none. |
| Next Review/Due Date | Enter the next planned review, reassessment, refresher, or expiry follow-up date in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Manager Approval | Enter approval status and approver name/date, e.g. Approved - Jane Smith - 2026-03-15; use Pending if not yet approved. |
| HR/FM Competence Record Verified By | Enter the name and role of the person who checked the record for completeness and evidence availability. |
| Record Last Updated Date | Enter the date this row was last updated in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Notes | Enter any brief relevant clarification, restriction, exception, or audit note; leave blank if none. |

### Maintenance

Owned by the FM Manager with support from HR/Learning & Development and the FM Compliance Coordinator. Update whenever a person joins, changes role, completes training, is reassessed, or evidence expires, and formally review at least quarterly using the HRIS, LMS, contractor onboarding records, competence framework, job descriptions, legal register, FM procedures, and certificate/evidence repository.

ISO41-023.title: Supplier/Contractor Performance Records
ISO41-023.content:

ISO41-024.title: Occupant Satisfaction Survey Results
ISO41-024.content:
| Metadata | Details |
|---|---|
| Document ID | [FM-REP-009] |
| Version | 1.0 |
| Owner | Facilities Management Manager |
| Effective Date | [Effective Date] |
| Framework | ISO 41001:2018 Facility Management Management Systems |
| Classification | Internal Confidential |

## Purpose

This report presents the results of the Occupant Satisfaction Survey conducted to support the organisation’s Facility Management System (FMS) monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation activities under ISO 41001:2018.

The purpose of this report is to:

- Capture the voice of building users regarding facility management services, workplace conditions and service outcomes.
- Evaluate whether facility management performance is meeting user needs, organisational objectives and applicable service level expectations.
- Identify trends, nonconformities, improvement opportunities and areas requiring corrective or preventive action.
- Provide evidence for management review, continual improvement and facility planning decisions.
- Support objective evaluation of occupant satisfaction as a key performance indicator of facility management effectiveness.

This report is intended to provide documented information demonstrating that the organisation has determined what needs to be monitored and measured, selected appropriate methods, analysed results, and evaluated facility management performance in accordance with ISO 41001:2018.

## Reporting Period & Scope

### Reporting Period

| Item | Details |
|---|---|
| Survey Period | [Survey Start Date] to [Survey End Date] |
| Reporting Period Covered | [Reporting Period, e.g., Q2 FY2025] |
| Date of Report Preparation | [Report Date] |
| Previous Survey Period for Comparison | [Previous Survey Period] |
| Next Scheduled Survey | [Next Survey Date] |

### Organisational Scope

This report applies to occupants and regular users of facilities within the scope of the organisation’s ISO 41001:2018 Facility Management System.

| Facility / Location | Included in Scope | Occupant Groups Surveyed | Notes |
|---|---:|---|---|
| [Head Office / Site A] | Yes | Employees, contractors, visitors where applicable | Main administrative workplace |
| [Operations Site / Site B] | Yes | Employees, maintenance contractors | Operational workplace |
| [Regional Office / Site C] | Yes | Employees | Smaller office population |
| Remote / hybrid workers | Partial | Employees using facilities periodically | Survey questions limited to facility interactions |
| Excluded locations | [Specify] | [Specify] | [Reason for exclusion] |

### Service Areas Assessed

The survey assessed occupant satisfaction across facility management service areas relevant to building user experience, including:

- Cleanliness and hygiene.
- Building comfort, including temperature, lighting, acoustics and air quality.
- Maintenance responsiveness and issue resolution.
- Safety, security and emergency readiness.
- Workspace suitability and availability.
- Accessibility and inclusivity.
- Reception, front-of-house and visitor support.
- Waste management and sustainability practices.
- Communication of facility works, disruptions and service updates.
- Overall satisfaction with facility management services.

### Limitations

The following limitations should be considered when interpreting results:

- Survey responses reflect occupant perceptions during the reporting period and may be affected by recent service events or disruptions.
- Results are dependent on response rates from each facility and occupant group.
- Some facilities had smaller respondent populations, which may affect statistical confidence.
- Open-text comments were reviewed for themes and risks but may not represent all occupants.
- Results should be considered alongside other monitoring data, including helpdesk performance, planned preventive maintenance completion, incident records, inspection findings and service provider performance reports.

## Executive Summary

The Occupant Satisfaction Survey achieved an overall satisfaction score of **[Overall Satisfaction Score]%**, compared with the target of **[Target Satisfaction Score]%** and the previous period result of **[Previous Score]%**. The survey indicates that occupants are generally satisfied with core facility services, particularly cleanliness, reception support and perceived safety. However, lower satisfaction was recorded in relation to temperature control, communication of works and maintenance response times in selected locations.

The survey generated **[Number of Responses]** valid responses from an estimated occupant population of **[Occupant Population]**, representing a response rate of **[Response Rate]%**. This response rate is considered **[adequate / below target / strong]** for evaluation purposes against the FMS monitoring plan.

### Summary of Key Results

| Measure | Current Result | Target / Threshold | Previous Result | Status |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Overall occupant satisfaction | [Score]% | [Target]% | [Previous Score]% | [Met / Not Met] |
| Response rate | [Response Rate]% | [Target Response Rate]% | [Previous Response Rate]% | [Met / Not Met] |
| Cleanliness and hygiene satisfaction | [Score]% | [Target]% | [Previous Score]% | [Met / Not Met] |
| Maintenance responsiveness satisfaction | [Score]% | [Target]% | [Previous Score]% | [Met / Not Met] |
| Building comfort satisfaction | [Score]% | [Target]% | [Previous Score]% | [Met / Not Met] |
| Safety and security satisfaction | [Score]% | [Target]% | [Previous Score]% | [Met / Not Met] |
| Communication satisfaction | [Score]% | [Target]% | [Previous Score]% | [Met / Not Met] |
| Net promoter-style workplace recommendation score | [Score] | [Target] | [Previous Score] | [Met / Not Met] |

### Key Strengths

The survey identified the following strengths:

- Occupants reported high confidence in general building safety and security arrangements.
- Cleanliness standards were rated positively across most sites.
- Reception and visitor management services received consistently favourable feedback.
- Occupants recognised improvements in waste segregation and availability of recycling points.
- Recent upgrades to selected meeting rooms and collaboration spaces were positively received.

### Key Areas Requiring Attention

The survey identified the following issues requiring management attention:

- Temperature variability and thermal discomfort in [Site / Building / Floor].
- Delays in closing maintenance requests or providing progress updates.
- Inconsistent communication regarding planned maintenance, access restrictions and disruptive works.
- Limited availability of quiet work areas during peak occupancy periods.
- Perceived gaps in accessibility for occupants with specific mobility or ergonomic needs.

### Overall Evaluation

Based on survey results and supporting facility performance data, occupant satisfaction is assessed as **[satisfactory / partially satisfactory / requiring improvement]** for the reporting period. The FMS is generally achieving intended outcomes; however, targeted corrective and improvement actions are required to address service consistency, communication and comfort-related issues.

## Methodology

### Survey Design

The survey was designed to measure occupant satisfaction with facility management services and workplace conditions within the scope of the ISO 41001 Facility Management System. The survey questions were aligned to the organisation’s facility management objectives, service level expectations and monitoring requirements under.

Survey questions were grouped into service categories and used a combination of:

- Five-point Likert scale questions.
- Yes / no questions for specific service availability or awareness.
- Multiple-choice questions for facility usage patterns.
- Open-text questions to capture qualitative feedback and improvement suggestions.
- Optional demographic or location identifiers to support trend analysis without unnecessary personal data collection.

### Rating Scale

| Rating | Description | Scoring Value |
|---:|---|---:|
| 5 | Very satisfied / strongly agree | 100% |
| 4 | Satisfied / agree | 75% |
| 3 | Neutral / neither agree nor disagree | 50% |
| 2 | Dissatisfied / disagree | 25% |
| 1 | Very dissatisfied / strongly disagree | 0% |
| N/A | Not applicable / no experience | Excluded from score calculation |

### Survey Distribution

| Item | Method |
|---|---|
| Survey platform | [Survey Tool / System] |
| Distribution channel | Email invitation, intranet notice and QR code posters in common areas |
| Eligible respondents | Occupants and regular users of in-scope facilities |
| Response method | Anonymous online submission |
| Reminder frequency | [Number] reminders during survey period |
| Accessibility provisions | Screen-reader compatible form and alternative format available on request |
| Language availability | [Languages] |

### Participation Metrics

| Facility / Location | Estimated Occupant Population | Valid Responses | Response Rate | Minimum Target Response Rate | Status |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| [Site A] | [Number] | [Number] | [Rate]% | [Target]% | [Met / Not Met] |
| [Site B] | [Number] | [Number] | [Rate]% | [Target]% | [Met / Not Met] |
| [Site C] | [Number] | [Number] | [Rate]% | [Target]% | [Met / Not Met] |

### Data Quality Controls

The following controls were applied to support reliability and integrity of survey results:

- Duplicate submissions were identified and removed where technically feasible.
- Incomplete responses were excluded where fewer than [Threshold]% of mandatory questions were answered.
- “Not applicable” responses were excluded from satisfaction score calculations.
- Open-text responses were reviewed to identify recurring themes, risks and improvement opportunities.
- Responses were aggregated to preserve anonymity and avoid attribution to individual occupants.
- Results were compared with prior-period survey data and operational performance metrics where available.
- Survey data was retained as documented information in accordance with the organisation’s document retention requirements.

### Evaluation Criteria

Survey results were evaluated against the following criteria:

| Evaluation Area | Target / Threshold | Source |
|---|---:|---|
| Overall occupant satisfaction | ≥ [Target]% | FM objectives and KPI register |
| Response rate | ≥ [Target]% | FMS monitoring plan |
| Service category satisfaction | ≥ [Target]% per category | FM service performance framework |
| Critical safety-related dissatisfaction | Escalation if > [Threshold]% dissatisfied | Risk management criteria |
| Negative trend from prior period | Escalation if decline > [Threshold] percentage points | Management review criteria |
| Repeated issue theme | Action required where theme appears in ≥ [Threshold] comments or across multiple sites | Corrective action process |

## Detailed Findings / Results (with structure)

### 1. Overall Satisfaction

| Measure | Current Period | Previous Period | Change | Target | Status |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|

| Satisfaction with FM services overall | [Score]% | [Score]% | [Increase / Decrease] [X] pp | [Target]% | [Met / Not Met] |

Occupants generally rated the facilities as **[positive / mixed / below expectation]**. Positive feedback focused on cleanliness, safety and location convenience. Negative feedback focused on comfort consistency, issue resolution and communication.

### 2. Cleanliness and Hygiene

#### Key Findings

- Cleaning standards were rated above target in [Location / Area].
- Washroom cleanliness improved compared with the previous reporting period following [intervention / contractor review].
- Lower scores were recorded for kitchen and break areas in [Location], primarily due to end-of-day cleanliness and user behaviour.
- Occupants noted occasional shortages of consumables in [Location / Floor].

- Temperature comfort was the lowest-rated service category for the period.

- Lighting satisfaction remained stable and above threshold in most areas.
- Noise levels were a concern in open-plan workspaces, especially near collaboration zones and circulation routes.

- Recurring issues were reported for [e.g., access doors, lifts, HVAC, meeting room equipment].
