# Privacy Policy (Public-Facing) - Arabic & English

# سياسة الخصوصية العامة - العربية والإنجليزية

## Purpose

This Privacy Policy explains how [Organisation Name] collects, uses, discloses, stores, protects, transfers and disposes of Personal Data when individuals interact with our websites, applications, platforms, products, services, offices, events, customer support channels, digital communications or other business activities.

This Policy is intended to provide clear, accessible information to Data Subjects about our privacy practices and their rights under the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law and its implementing requirements.

For the purposes of this Policy:

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Personal Data | Any data, regardless of its form or source, that may identify an individual directly or indirectly, including name, identification number, contact details, location data, online identifiers, images, voice recordings, financial information, employment information, health-related information and any other data linked to an identifiable person. |
| Sensitive Personal Data | Personal Data that requires additional protection, including data revealing racial or ethnic origin, religious, intellectual or political belief, security data, biometric data, genetic data, health data, credit data, location data, or data indicating that an individual is unknown to one or both parents. |
| Data Subject | The individual to whom Personal Data relates. |
| Processing | Any operation performed on Personal Data, including collection, recording, storage, organisation, modification, use, disclosure, transfer, publication, deletion or destruction. |
| Controller | The entity that determines the purpose and means of Processing Personal Data. |
| Processor | The entity that Processes Personal Data on behalf of the Controller. |
| Consent | A clear, informed indication by which the Data Subject agrees to the Processing of their Personal Data. |

---

تهدف سياسة الخصوصية هذه إلى توضيح كيفية قيام [اسم الجهة] بجمع البيانات الشخصية واستخدامها والإفصاح عنها وتخزينها وحمايتها ونقلها والتخلص منها عند تفاعل الأفراد مع مواقعنا الإلكترونية أو تطبيقاتنا أو منصاتنا أو منتجاتنا أو خدماتنا أو مقارنا أو فعالياتنا أو قنوات الدعم أو الاتصالات الرقمية أو أنشطة الأعمال الأخرى.

تهدف هذه السياسة إلى تقديم معلومات واضحة وميسرة لأصحاب البيانات حول ممارسات الخصوصية لدينا وحقوقهم بموجب نظام حماية البيانات الشخصية في المملكة العربية السعودية ومتطلباته التنفيذية.

لأغراض هذه السياسة:

| المصطلح | المعنى |
|---|---|
| البيانات الشخصية | أي بيانات، أياً كان شكلها أو مصدرها، من شأنها أن تؤدي إلى معرفة الفرد على وجه التحديد أو تجعل التعرف عليه ممكناً بصفة مباشرة أو غير مباشرة، مثل الاسم، رقم الهوية، بيانات التواصل، بيانات الموقع، المعرّفات الإلكترونية، الصور، التسجيلات الصوتية، البيانات المالية، بيانات العمل، البيانات الصحية، وأي بيانات أخرى مرتبطة بشخص يمكن تحديد هويته. |
| البيانات الشخصية الحساسة | البيانات الشخصية التي تتطلب حماية إضافية، بما في ذلك البيانات التي تكشف عن الأصل العرقي أو القبلي، أو المعتقد الديني أو الفكري أو السياسي، أو البيانات الأمنية، أو البيانات الحيوية، أو الوراثية، أو الصحية، أو الائتمانية، أو بيانات الموقع، أو البيانات التي تدل على أن أحد الوالدين أو كليهما مجهول. |
| صاحب البيانات | الفرد الذي تتعلق به البيانات الشخصية. |
| المعالجة | أي عملية تتم على البيانات الشخصية، بما في ذلك الجمع، التسجيل، التخزين، التنظيم، التعديل، الاستخدام، الإفصاح، النقل، النشر، الحذف أو الإتلاف. |
| جهة التحكم | الجهة التي تحدد أغراض ووسائل معالجة البيانات الشخصية. |
| جهة المعالجة | الجهة التي تعالج البيانات الشخصية نيابة عن جهة التحكم. |
| الموافقة | تعبير واضح ومستنير من صاحب البيانات يوافق بموجبه على معالجة بياناته الشخصية. |

## Scope

This Policy applies to all Personal Data Processed by [Organisation Name] where we act as a Controller, including Personal Data relating to:

- Customers, prospective customers and service users.
- Website and application visitors.
- Individuals who contact us through support, sales, complaints, social media or other communication channels.
- Event participants, visitors and guests.
- Suppliers, business partners and representatives of corporate customers.
- Job applicants, where recruitment information is collected through public-facing channels.
- Any other individual whose Personal Data is collected in connection with our products, services or business activities.

This Policy applies to Processing performed in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and, where permitted, Processing involving international transfers or access from outside the Kingdom.

This Policy does not replace employee privacy notices, supplier contractual privacy terms, product-specific privacy notices or consent notices that may apply to specific activities. Where a specific notice provides additional detail, it shall be read together with this Policy.

---

تنطبق هذه السياسة على جميع البيانات الشخصية التي تعالجها [اسم الجهة] عندما تكون جهة تحكم، بما في ذلك البيانات الشخصية المتعلقة بـ:

- العملاء والعملاء المحتملين ومستخدمي الخدمات.
- زوار المواقع الإلكترونية والتطبيقات.
- الأفراد الذين يتواصلون معنا عبر قنوات الدعم أو المبيعات أو الشكاوى أو وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي أو أي قنوات تواصل أخرى.
- المشاركين في الفعاليات والزوار والضيوف.
- الموردين وشركاء الأعمال وممثلي العملاء من الشركات.
- المتقدمين للوظائف، عندما يتم جمع معلومات التوظيف عبر قنوات عامة.
- أي فرد آخر تُجمع بياناته الشخصية فيما يتعلق بمنتجاتنا أو خدماتنا أو أنشطتنا التجارية.

تنطبق هذه السياسة على المعالجة التي تتم داخل المملكة العربية السعودية، وكذلك - متى كان ذلك مسموحاً - على المعالجة التي تتضمن نقل البيانات أو الوصول إليها من خارج المملكة.

لا تحل هذه السياسة محل إشعارات الخصوصية الخاصة بالموظفين أو شروط الخصوصية التعاقدية للموردين أو إشعارات الخصوصية الخاصة بمنتجات محددة أو إشعارات الموافقة التي قد تنطبق على أنشطة معينة. وعندما يقدم إشعار محدد تفاصيل إضافية، فيجب قراءته مع هذه السياسة.

## Policy Statements

1. **[Organisation Name] shall Process Personal Data lawfully, fairly and transparently.** We shall only Process Personal Data for clear, legitimate and specific purposes and shall provide individuals with appropriate privacy information before or at the time their Personal Data is collected, unless a lawful exception applies.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بمعالجة البيانات الشخصية بطريقة نظامية وعادلة وشفافة.** ولا تتم معالجة البيانات الشخصية إلا لأغراض واضحة ومشروعة ومحددة، كما تلتزم الجهة بتزويد الأفراد بمعلومات الخصوصية المناسبة قبل أو عند جمع بياناتهم الشخصية، ما لم ينطبق استثناء نظامي.

2. **[Organisation Name] shall collect only the Personal Data needed for identified purposes.** We shall not collect excessive, irrelevant or unnecessary Personal Data and shall review collection points to ensure that mandatory and optional fields are clearly distinguished.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بجمع البيانات الشخصية اللازمة فقط للأغراض المحددة.** ولا يجوز جمع بيانات شخصية مفرطة أو غير ذات صلة أو غير ضرورية، ويجب مراجعة نقاط الجمع للتأكد من التمييز الواضح بين الحقول الإلزامية والاختيارية.

3. **[Organisation Name] shall inform Data Subjects of the purposes of Processing.** Privacy notices shall describe, in clear language, what Personal Data is collected, why it is collected, how it is used, the legal basis or permitted reason for Processing, who it may be shared with, whether it may be transferred outside the Kingdom, how long it will be retained, and how individuals may exercise their rights.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بإبلاغ أصحاب البيانات بأغراض المعالجة.** ويجب أن توضح إشعارات الخصوصية بلغة واضحة ماهية البيانات الشخصية التي يتم جمعها، وسبب جمعها، وكيفية استخدامها، والأساس أو السبب المسموح للمعالجة، والجهات التي قد تتم مشاركة البيانات معها، وما إذا كان من الممكن نقلها خارج المملكة، ومدة الاحتفاظ بها، وكيف يمكن للأفراد ممارسة حقوقهم.

4. **[Organisation Name] shall obtain Consent where required.** Where Consent is required, it shall be freely given, specific, informed and clear. Consent shall not be bundled with unrelated terms, and individuals shall be able to withdraw Consent through accessible methods unless Processing is permitted on another lawful basis.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بالحصول على الموافقة عند الحاجة.** وعندما تكون الموافقة مطلوبة، فيجب أن تكون صادرة بحرية، ومحددة، ومستنيرة، وواضحة. ولا يجوز دمج الموافقة مع شروط غير ذات صلة، ويجب تمكين الأفراد من سحب موافقتهم بوسائل ميسرة ما لم تكن المعالجة مسموحة بناءً على أساس نظامي آخر.

5. **[Organisation Name] shall Process Sensitive Personal Data only with additional safeguards.** Sensitive Personal Data shall be collected and used only where necessary, authorised and proportionate. Additional access controls, encryption, monitoring and approval requirements shall be applied according to the sensitivity and risk of the Processing.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بمعالجة البيانات الشخصية الحساسة بضمانات إضافية.** ولا يجوز جمع البيانات الشخصية الحساسة أو استخدامها إلا عند الضرورة وبما يكون مصرحاً به ومتناسباً مع الغرض. وتطبق ضوابط وصول إضافية وتشفير ومراقبة ومتطلبات موافقة وفقاً لحساسية المعالجة ومخاطرها.

6. **[Organisation Name] shall use Personal Data only for the purposes communicated to the Data Subject.** Personal Data shall not be used for incompatible new purposes unless the Data Subject is informed and, where required, Consent or another permitted basis is obtained.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] باستخدام البيانات الشخصية فقط للأغراض التي تم إبلاغ صاحب البيانات بها.** ولا يجوز استخدام البيانات الشخصية لأغراض جديدة غير متوافقة إلا بعد إبلاغ صاحب البيانات، والحصول على الموافقة أو أي أساس مسموح آخر عند الحاجة.

7. **[Organisation Name] shall maintain accurate and up-to-date Personal Data.** Reasonable steps shall be taken to ensure that Personal Data is accurate, complete and updated where necessary. Data Subjects shall be provided with reasonable methods to request correction or completion of their Personal Data.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بالحفاظ على دقة البيانات الشخصية وتحديثها.** ويجب اتخاذ خطوات معقولة لضمان دقة البيانات الشخصية واكتمالها وتحديثها عند الحاجة. كما يجب توفير وسائل معقولة لأصحاب البيانات لطلب تصحيح بياناتهم الشخصية أو استكمالها.

8. **[Organisation Name] shall retain Personal Data only for as long as necessary.** Retention periods shall be based on the purpose of Processing, legal requirements, contractual obligations, legitimate business needs and dispute-resolution requirements. Personal Data shall be securely deleted, anonymised or destroyed when no longer needed, unless retention is legally required or permitted.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بالاحتفاظ بالبيانات الشخصية للمدة اللازمة فقط.** وتحدد مدد الاحتفاظ بناءً على غرض المعالجة، والمتطلبات النظامية، والالتزامات التعاقدية، واحتياجات العمل المشروعة، ومتطلبات تسوية النزاعات. ويجب حذف البيانات الشخصية أو إخفاء هويتها أو إتلافها بطريقة آمنة عند انتفاء الحاجة إليها، ما لم يكن الاحتفاظ بها مطلوباً أو مسموحاً به نظاماً.

 | Data Category | Typical Retention Period | Disposal Method |
 |---|---:|---|
 | Customer account and service records | Duration of relationship plus [X years] | Secure deletion or archival deletion |
 | Transaction and billing records | [X years] after transaction completion | Secure deletion or controlled destruction |
 | Customer support records | [X years] after case closure | Secure deletion |
 | Marketing preferences and Consent records | Until withdrawal plus [X years] | Suppression list retention or secure deletion |
 | Website logs and analytics identifiers | [X months] unless required for security investigation | Automated deletion or aggregation |
 | Complaint and rights-request records | [X years] after closure | Secure deletion |
 | Job applicant records | [X months/years] after recruitment decision | Secure deletion or return where applicable |
 | CCTV or visitor logs, where applicable | [X days/months] unless required for investigation | Overwrite or secure deletion |

 | فئة البيانات | مدة الاحتفاظ المعتادة | طريقة التخلص |
 |---|---:|---|
 | سجلات حسابات العملاء والخدمات | مدة العلاقة بالإضافة إلى [X سنوات] | حذف آمن أو حذف من الأرشيف |
 | سجلات المعاملات والفوترة | [X سنوات] بعد إتمام المعاملة | حذف آمن أو إتلاف مضبوط |
 | سجلات دعم العملاء | [X سنوات] بعد إغلاق الحالة | حذف آمن |
 | تفضيلات التسويق وسجلات الموافقة | حتى سحب الموافقة بالإضافة إلى [X سنوات] | الاحتفاظ بقائمة المنع أو الحذف الآمن |
 | سجلات المواقع الإلكترونية ومعرّفات التحليلات | [X أشهر] ما لم تكن مطلوبة لتحقيق أمني | حذف آلي أو تجميع دون تحديد الهوية |
 | سجلات الشكاوى وطلبات الحقوق | [X سنوات] بعد الإغلاق | حذف آمن |
 | سجلات المتقدمين للوظائف | [X أشهر/سنوات] بعد قرار التوظيف | حذف آمن أو إعادة السجلات عند الاقتضاء |
 | كاميرات المراقبة أو سجلات الزوار، إن وجدت | [X أيام/أشهر] ما لم تكن مطلوبة للتحقيق | الكتابة فوقها أو حذفها بشكل آمن |

9. **[Organisation Name] shall protect Personal Data using appropriate security measures.** Security measures shall include access control, authentication, encryption where appropriate, secure configuration, network protection, monitoring, vulnerability management, employee awareness, secure disposal and incident response.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بحماية البيانات الشخصية باستخدام تدابير أمنية مناسبة.** وتشمل التدابير الأمنية ضوابط الوصول، والتحقق من الهوية، والتشفير عند الاقتضاء، والتهيئة الآمنة، وحماية الشبكات، والمراقبة، وإدارة الثغرات، وتوعية الموظفين، والتخلص الآمن، والاستجابة للحوادث.

10. **[Organisation Name] shall restrict access to Personal Data on a need-to-know basis.** Personnel, contractors and service providers shall access Personal Data only where required for authorised duties. Access shall be reviewed periodically and removed promptly when no longer required.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بتقييد الوصول إلى البيانات الشخصية على أساس الحاجة إلى المعرفة.** ولا يجوز للموظفين أو المتعاقدين أو مقدمي الخدمات الوصول إلى البيانات الشخصية إلا عند الحاجة لأداء مهام مصرح بها. ويجب مراجعة صلاحيات الوصول دورياً وإزالتها فور انتفاء الحاجة إليها.

11. **[Organisation Name] shall manage Processors and third parties responsibly.** We shall share Personal Data with Processors, service providers and business partners only where necessary and subject to appropriate contractual, confidentiality, security and privacy obligations.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بإدارة جهات المعالجة والأطراف الثالثة بمسؤولية.** ولا تتم مشاركة البيانات الشخصية مع جهات المعالجة أو مقدمي الخدمات أو شركاء الأعمال إلا عند الضرورة وبموجب التزامات تعاقدية مناسبة تتعلق بالسرية والأمن والخصوصية.

12. **[Organisation Name] shall not sell Personal Data.** We shall not sell, rent or trade Personal Data to third parties. Any disclosure shall be limited to permitted purposes such as service delivery, legal compliance, protection of rights, transaction support, authorised business operations or other purposes communicated to the Data Subject.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بعدم بيع البيانات الشخصية.** ولا يجوز بيع البيانات الشخصية أو تأجيرها أو المتاجرة بها مع أطراف ثالثة. ويقتصر أي إفصاح على الأغراض المسموح بها مثل تقديم الخدمات، أو الامتثال النظامي، أو حماية الحقوق، أو دعم المعاملات، أو العمليات التجارية المصرح بها، أو أي أغراض أخرى يتم إبلاغ صاحب البيانات بها.

13. **[Organisation Name] shall control international transfers of Personal Data.** Personal Data shall not be transferred, stored or accessed outside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia unless the transfer is permitted, necessary for a legitimate purpose, subject to appropriate safeguards, and approved through [Organisation Name]’s internal privacy governance process.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بضبط نقل البيانات الشخصية خارج المملكة.** ولا يجوز نقل البيانات الشخصية أو تخزينها أو الوصول إليها من خارج المملكة العربية السعودية إلا إذا كان النقل مسموحاً، ولازماً لغرض مشروع، وخاضعاً لضمانات مناسبة، ومعتمداً من خلال عملية حوكمة الخصوصية الداخلية لدى [اسم الجهة].

14. **[Organisation Name] shall support Data Subject rights.** Individuals shall be provided with accessible methods to request information about Processing, access to their Personal Data, correction or completion of Personal Data, deletion where applicable, withdrawal of Consent where Processing is based on Consent, and any other rights available under applicable privacy requirements.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بدعم حقوق أصحاب البيانات.** ويجب توفير وسائل ميسرة للأفراد لطلب معلومات عن المعالجة، والوصول إلى بياناتهم الشخصية، وتصحيح البيانات الشخصية أو استكمالها، وحذفها عند الاقتضاء، وسحب الموافقة عندما تكون المعالجة قائمة على الموافقة، وأي حقوق أخرى متاحة بموجب متطلبات الخصوصية المعمول بها.

15. **[Organisation Name] shall respond to Data Subject requests within defined timelines.** Requests shall be verified, logged, assessed and answered without undue delay. Where additional time is needed due to complexity or volume, the Data Subject shall be informed where required.

16. **[Organisation Name] shall verify the identity of requestors before fulfilling privacy requests.** We may request information necessary to confirm identity and authority, especially where the request involves access, correction, deletion or disclosure of Personal Data.

18. **[Organisation Name] shall handle Personal Data breaches promptly and responsibly.** Suspected or confirmed breaches involving Personal Data shall be assessed, contained, investigated, documented and escalated. Where notification is required, affected Data Subjects and competent authorities shall be notified in accordance with applicable requirements.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بالتعامل مع حوادث اختراق البيانات الشخصية بسرعة ومسؤولية.** ويجب تقييم الحوادث المشتبه بها أو المؤكدة التي تشمل بيانات شخصية واحتواؤها والتحقيق فيها وتوثيقها وتصعيدها. وعندما يكون الإبلاغ مطلوباً، يتم إخطار أصحاب البيانات المتأثرين والجهات المختصة وفقاً للمتطلبات المعمول بها.

19. **[Organisation Name] shall use cookies and similar technologies transparently.** Where our websites or applications use cookies, pixels, software development kits, device identifiers or similar technologies, we shall provide relevant information about their purpose and, where required, provide appropriate preference or Consent mechanisms.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] باستخدام ملفات تعريف الارتباط والتقنيات المشابهة بشفافية.** وعندما تستخدم مواقعنا أو تطبيقاتنا ملفات تعريف الارتباط أو وحدات البكسل أو أدوات تطوير البرمجيات أو معرّفات الأجهزة أو التقنيات المشابهة، فإننا نوضح الغرض منها، ونوفر عند الحاجة آليات مناسبة لإدارة التفضيلات أو الحصول على الموافقة.

20. **[Organisation Name] shall ensure that direct marketing respects privacy choices.** Marketing communications shall be sent only where permitted. Individuals shall be provided with a clear way to opt out or withdraw Consent from marketing messages, and marketing suppression preferences shall be honoured.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بضمان احترام الاتصالات التسويقية المباشرة لاختيارات الخصوصية.** ولا ترسل الاتصالات التسويقية إلا عندما يكون ذلك مسموحاً. ويجب توفير وسيلة واضحة للأفراد لإلغاء الاشتراك أو سحب الموافقة على الرسائل التسويقية، والالتزام بتفضيلات منع التسويق.

21. **[Organisation Name] shall protect children’s and minors’ Personal Data with additional care.** Where services may involve children or minors, we shall apply appropriate age-related safeguards, collect only necessary information, provide clear notices suitable for the audience, and obtain guardian involvement where required.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بحماية بيانات الأطفال والقُصّر الشخصية بعناية إضافية.** وعندما قد تشمل الخدمات أطفالاً أو قُصّراً، نطبق ضمانات مناسبة للعمر، ونجمع المعلومات الضرورية فقط، ونقدم إشعارات واضحة ومناسبة للجمهور، ونحصل على مشاركة الولي أو الوصي عند الحاجة.

22. **[Organisation Name] shall apply privacy by design and default.** New products, services, systems, campaigns, integrations and data-sharing arrangements shall consider privacy requirements from the planning stage and shall apply default settings that limit unnecessary Personal Data Processing.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بتطبيق الخصوصية حسب التصميم وبشكل افتراضي.** ويجب مراعاة متطلبات الخصوصية منذ مرحلة التخطيط عند إطلاق منتجات أو خدمات أو أنظمة أو حملات أو تكاملات أو ترتيبات مشاركة بيانات جديدة، كما يجب تطبيق إعدادات افتراضية تحد من المعالجة غير الضرورية للبيانات الشخصية.

23. **[Organisation Name] shall assess privacy risks for higher-risk Processing.** Privacy risk assessments shall be completed for Processing that may involve Sensitive Personal Data, large-scale Processing, new technologies, profiling, automated decision-making, systematic monitoring, international transfers or significant impact on individuals.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بتقييم مخاطر الخصوصية للمعالجة ذات المخاطر الأعلى.** ويجب إجراء تقييمات لمخاطر الخصوصية عند المعالجة التي قد تشمل بيانات شخصية حساسة، أو معالجة واسعة النطاق، أو تقنيات جديدة، أو تصنيف الأفراد، أو اتخاذ قرارات آلية، أو مراقبة منهجية، أو نقل دولي، أو تأثيراً كبيراً على الأفراد.

24. **[Organisation Name] shall document privacy decisions and Processing activities.** Records shall be maintained to demonstrate what Personal Data is Processed, for what purposes, by which systems and parties, where it is stored, how long it is retained, and what safeguards apply.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بتوثيق قرارات الخصوصية وأنشطة المعالجة.** ويجب الاحتفاظ بسجلات توضح البيانات الشخصية التي تتم معالجتها، وأغراض المعالجة، والأنظمة والجهات المشاركة، ومواقع التخزين، ومدد الاحتفاظ، والضمانات المطبقة.

25. **[Organisation Name] shall train personnel who handle Personal Data.** Employees and contractors with access to Personal Data shall receive appropriate privacy and security awareness, including confidentiality obligations, lawful handling, incident reporting and Data Subject rights.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بتدريب الموظفين الذين يتعاملون مع البيانات الشخصية.** ويجب أن يتلقى الموظفون والمتعاقدون الذين يمكنهم الوصول إلى البيانات الشخصية توعية مناسبة بالخصوصية والأمن، بما في ذلك التزامات السرية، والتعامل النظامي مع البيانات، والإبلاغ عن الحوادث، وحقوق أصحاب البيانات.

26. **[Organisation Name] shall maintain confidentiality of Personal Data.** Personnel and third parties shall not disclose Personal Data except where authorised and necessary for legitimate business, service, legal or security purposes.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بالحفاظ على سرية البيانات الشخصية.** ولا يجوز للموظفين أو الأطراف الثالثة الإفصاح عن البيانات الشخصية إلا عند وجود تصريح بذلك وعندما يكون الإفصاح ضرورياً لأغراض عمل أو خدمة أو أغراض نظامية أو أمنية مشروعة.

27. **[Organisation Name] shall provide this Policy in Arabic and English.** The Arabic version shall be made available to individuals in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Where there is a difference in interpretation, [select: the Arabic version shall prevail / both versions shall be interpreted consistently, and the Arabic version shall prevail where required].

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بتوفير هذه السياسة باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية.** ويجب إتاحة النسخة العربية للأفراد في المملكة العربية السعودية. وفي حال وجود اختلاف في التفسير، [اختر: تكون النسخة العربية هي المعتمدة / يتم تفسير النسختين بشكل متسق، وتسود النسخة العربية عند الاقتضاء].

28. **[Organisation Name] shall make this Policy readily available.** This Policy shall be published on our website and, where relevant, made available through applications, customer portals, service locations, forms and other appropriate channels.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بإتاحة هذه السياسة بسهولة.** ويجب نشر هذه السياسة على موقعنا الإلكتروني، وعند الاقتضاء، إتاحتها عبر التطبيقات وبوابات العملاء ومواقع تقديم الخدمة والنماذج والقنوات المناسبة الأخرى.

29. **[Organisation Name] shall notify individuals of material changes to this Policy.** Where changes materially affect how Personal Data is Processed, we shall take reasonable steps to inform Data Subjects through appropriate channels before or at the time the changes take effect.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بإخطار الأفراد بالتغييرات الجوهرية على هذه السياسة.** وعندما تؤثر التغييرات بشكل جوهري على كيفية معالجة البيانات الشخصية، نتخذ خطوات معقولة لإبلاغ أصحاب البيانات عبر القنوات المناسبة قبل أو عند سريان التغييرات.

30. **[Organisation Name] shall respond to complaints and concerns in good faith.** Privacy complaints shall be acknowledged, investigated and resolved fairly. Individuals may also contact the competent authority where they believe their Personal Data has been handled in a manner inconsistent with applicable privacy requirements.

 **تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بالتعامل مع الشكاوى والمخاوف بحسن نية.** ويجب الإقرار بشكاوى الخصوصية والتحقيق فيها وحلها بشكل عادل. كما يمكن للأفراد التواصل مع الجهة المختصة إذا اعتقدوا أن بياناتهم الشخصية عولجت بطريقة لا تتوافق مع متطلبات الخصوصية المعمول بها.

## Roles & Responsibilities

| Role | Responsibilities |
|---|---|
| Board / Executive Management | Approves the organisation’s commitment to privacy, ensures adequate resources are available, and supports accountability for lawful and ethical Personal Data Processing. |
| Privacy Office / Data Protection Officer | Owns this Policy, advises on privacy requirements, manages Data Subject requests, supports privacy risk assessments, oversees privacy notices, monitors privacy compliance and coordinates with competent authorities where required. |
| Legal Department | Advises on legal grounds for Processing, contracts, disclosures, retention obligations, complaints, regulatory communications and cross-border transfer requirements. |
| Information Security | Implements and monitors technical and organisational security controls to protect Personal Data, supports breach response, and advises on security risks in systems and third-party arrangements. |
| Business Process Owners | Ensure Personal Data in their processes is collected, used, shared, retained and disposed of in accordance with this Policy and approved privacy notices. |
| Marketing and Communications | Ensures marketing activities use appropriate Consent or permitted grounds, maintain opt-out mechanisms, honour communication preferences and use approved messaging. |
| Customer Support / Service Teams | Direct Data Subject requests and complaints to the appropriate privacy channel, protect customer information during interactions and follow identity-verification requirements. |
| Procurement / Vendor Management | Ensures third parties that Process Personal Data are assessed, approved and contractually bound to privacy, confidentiality and security requirements. |
| Human Resources | Applies this Policy to public-facing recruitment activities and supports privacy awareness for employees and contractors. |
| Employees and Contractors | Handle Personal Data only as authorised, protect confidentiality, complete required training, report suspected incidents and comply with this Policy. |
| Processors and Service Providers | Process Personal Data only under documented instructions, protect Personal Data, support Data Subject rights and breach response, and comply with contractual obligations. |

| مجلس الإدارة / الإدارة التنفيذية | اعتماد التزام الجهة بالخصوصية، وضمان توفر الموارد الكافية، ودعم المساءلة عن المعالجة النظامية والأخلاقية للبيانات الشخصية. |
| مكتب الخصوصية / مسؤول حماية البيانات | امتلاك هذه السياسة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن متطلبات الخصوصية، وإدارة طلبات أصحاب البيانات، ودعم تقييمات مخاطر الخصوصية، والإشراف على إشعارات الخصوصية، ومراقبة الامتثال، والتنسيق مع الجهات المختصة عند الحاجة. |
| الإدارة القانونية | تقديم المشورة بشأن أسس المعالجة، والعقود، والإفصاحات، والتزامات الاحتفاظ، والشكاوى، والتواصل التنظيمي، ومتطلبات نقل البيانات خارج المملكة. |
| أمن المعلومات | تنفيذ ومراقبة الضوابط التقنية والتنظيمية لحماية البيانات الشخصية، ودعم الاستجابة للحوادث، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المخاطر الأمنية في الأنظمة وترتيبات الأطراف الثالثة. |
| مالكو العمليات التجارية | ضمان جمع البيانات الشخصية واستخدامها ومشاركتها والاحتفاظ بها والتخلص منها ضمن عملياتهم وفقاً لهذه السياسة وإشعارات الخصوصية المعتمدة. |
| التسويق والاتصال | ضمان تنفيذ الأنشطة التسويقية بناءً على موافقة مناسبة أو أساس مسموح، والحفاظ على آليات إلغاء الاشتراك، واحترام تفضيلات التواصل، واستخدام الرسائل المعتمدة. |
| فرق خدمة العملاء / الدعم | توجيه طلبات وشكاوى أصحاب البيانات إلى قناة الخصوصية المناسبة، وحماية معلومات العملاء أثناء التفاعل، واتباع متطلبات التحقق من الهوية. |
| المشتريات / إدارة الموردين | ضمان تقييم واعتماد الأطراف الثالثة التي تعالج البيانات الشخصية وإلزامها تعاقدياً بمتطلبات الخصوصية والسرية والأمن. |
| الموارد البشرية | تطبيق هذه السياسة على أنشطة التوظيف العامة ودعم التوعية بالخصوصية للموظفين والمتعاقدين. |
| الموظفون والمتعاقدون | التعامل مع البيانات الشخصية فقط عند التصريح، وحماية السرية، واستكمال التدريب المطلوب، والإبلاغ عن الحوادث المشتبه بها، والالتزام بهذه السياسة. |
| جهات المعالجة ومقدمو الخدمات | معالجة البيانات الشخصية فقط وفقاً للتعليمات الموثقة، وحماية البيانات الشخصية، ودعم حقوق أصحاب البيانات والاستجابة للحوادث، والالتزام بالمتطلبات التعاقدية. |

## Compliance, Monitoring & Enforcement

[Organisation Name] shall maintain a privacy governance programme to support compliance with this Policy and applicable privacy requirements. The programme shall include documented Processing records, privacy notices, Consent records where applicable, Data Subject request logs, third-party assessments, retention schedules, privacy risk assessments, training records and incident records.

Monitoring activities shall include, as appropriate:

- Periodic review of public privacy notices and collection forms.
- Testing of Data Subject request handling.
- Review of Consent and marketing preference mechanisms.
- Review of third-party contracts and Processing arrangements.
- Review of international transfer approvals and safeguards.
- Monitoring of access to systems containing Personal Data.
- Review of retention and disposal activities.
- Assessment of privacy incidents, complaints and trends.
- Periodic reporting to executive management.

| Compliance Activity | Frequency | Owner | Evidence |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Privacy Policy review | At least annually | Privacy Office | Approved policy version and change log |
| Privacy notice review | At least annually and upon material process change | Privacy Office / Business Owner | Published notice and approval record |
| Data Subject request quality review | Quarterly | Privacy Office | Request log and sample review results |
| Third-party privacy review | Before onboarding and periodically thereafter | Procurement / Privacy Office | Due diligence and contract records |
| Consent mechanism review | Semi-annually | Marketing / Privacy Office | Consent logs and preference testing |
| Retention compliance review | Annually | Records Owner / Privacy Office | Disposal records and exceptions log |
| Privacy training completion review | Annually | Human Resources / Privacy Office | Training completion report |
| Personal Data breach exercise | At least annually | Information Security / Privacy Office | Exercise report and improvement actions |

| نشاط الامتثال | التكرار | المالك | الدليل |
|---|---:|---|---|
| مراجعة سياسة الخصوصية | سنوياً على الأقل | مكتب الخصوصية | نسخة السياسة المعتمدة وسجل التغييرات |
| مراجعة إشعارات الخصوصية | سنوياً على الأقل وعند حدوث تغيير جوهري في العملية | مكتب الخصوصية / مالك العملية | الإشعار المنشور وسجل الاعتماد |
| مراجعة جودة التعامل مع طلبات أصحاب البيانات | ربع سنوي | مكتب الخصوصية | سجل الطلبات ونتائج مراجعة العينات |
| مراجعة خصوصية الأطراف الثالثة | قبل التعاقد وبشكل دوري بعد ذلك | المشتريات / مكتب الخصوصية | سجلات العناية الواجبة والعقود |
| مراجعة آليات الموافقة | نصف سنوي | التسويق / مكتب الخصوصية | سجلات الموافقة واختبار التفضيلات |
| مراجعة الامتثال للاحتفاظ | سنوي | مالك السجلات / مكتب الخصوصية | سجلات التخلص وسجل الاستثناءات |
| مراجعة إكمال تدريب الخصوصية | سنوي | الموارد البشرية / مكتب الخصوصية | تقرير إكمال التدريب |
| تمرين التعامل مع اختراق البيانات الشخصية | سنوياً على الأقل | أمن المعلومات / مكتب الخصوصية | تقرير التمرين وإجراءات التحسين |

Violations of this Policy may result in corrective action, including access restriction, retraining, disciplinary action, contractual remedies, suspension of Processing, vendor termination, incident escalation or notification to competent authorities where required.

Any employee, contractor or third party who becomes aware of a suspected privacy breach, unauthorised disclosure, inappropriate use of Personal Data or non-compliance with this Policy shall report it immediately through [incident reporting channel] or to [Privacy Office / Information Security].

---

تلتزم [اسم الجهة] بالمحافظة على برنامج لحوكمة الخصوصية لدعم الامتثال لهذه السياسة ومتطلبات الخصوصية المعمول بها. ويشمل البرنامج سجلات موثقة لأنشطة المعالجة، وإشعارات الخصوصية، وسجلات الموافقة عند الاقتضاء، وسجلات طلبات أصحاب البيانات، وتقييمات الأطراف الثالثة، وجداول الاحتفاظ، وتقييمات مخاطر الخصوصية، وسجلات التدريب، وسجلات الحوادث.

تشمل أنشطة المراقبة، بحسب الاقتضاء:

- المراجعة الدورية لإشعارات الخصوصية العامة ونماذج جمع البيانات.
- اختبار إجراءات التعامل مع طلبات أصحاب البيانات.
- مراجعة آليات الموافقة وتفضيلات التسويق.
- مراجعة عقود الأطراف الثالثة وترتيبات المعالجة.
- مراجعة اعتمادات وضمانات نقل البيانات خارج المملكة.
- مراقبة الوصول إلى الأنظمة التي تحتوي على بيانات شخصية.
- مراجعة أنشطة الاحتفاظ والتخلص.
- تقييم حوادث الخصوصية والشكاوى والاتجاهات.
- تقديم تقارير دورية للإدارة التنفيذية.

قد يؤدي انتهاك هذه السياسة إلى اتخاذ إجراءات تصحيحية، بما في ذلك تقييد الوصول، أو إعادة التدريب، أو الإجراءات التأديبية، أو تطبيق الجزاءات التعاقدية، أو تعليق المعالجة، أو إنهاء علاقة المورد، أو تصعيد الحادث، أو إخطار الجهات المختصة عند الحاجة.

يجب على أي موظف أو متعاقد أو طرف ثالث يصبح على علم بحادث خصوصية مشتبه به، أو إفصاح غير مصرح به، أو استخدام غير مناسب للبيانات الشخصية، أو عدم امتثال لهذه السياسة، الإبلاغ عنه فوراً عبر [قناة الإبلاغ عن الحوادث] أو إلى [مكتب الخصوصية / أمن المعلومات].

## Exceptions

Exceptions to this Policy shall be limited, documented, risk-assessed and approved before implementation, unless urgent action is necessary to protect individuals, systems, legal interests or public safety.

An exception request shall include:

- The specific Policy requirement for which an exception is requested.
- The business, legal, technical or operational justification.
- The categories of Personal Data affected.
- The number and type of Data Subjects affected.
- The Processing purpose and duration.
- The risks to Data Subjects and to [Organisation Name].
- Compensating controls and safeguards.
- The proposed expiry date.
- Approvals from the relevant Business Owner, Privacy Office, Information Security and Legal Department where applicable.

| Exception Type | Approval Required | Maximum Initial Duration | Minimum Safeguards |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Temporary operational exception | Business Owner and Privacy Office | [90 days] | Documented risk acceptance and compensating controls |
| Security-related exception | Information Security and Privacy Office | [90 days] | Security risk assessment and monitoring |
| Third-party Processing exception | Procurement, Privacy Office and Legal | [180 days] | Contractual controls and documented remediation plan |
| International transfer exception | Privacy Office, Legal and Executive Sponsor | [180 days] | Transfer assessment, safeguards and approval record |
| Retention exception | Records Owner, Privacy Office and Legal | [1 year] | Legal basis, restricted access and review date |

| نوع الاستثناء | الاعتماد المطلوب | الحد الأقصى للمدة الأولية | الحد الأدنى من الضمانات |
|---|---|---:|---|
| استثناء تشغيلي مؤقت | مالك العملية ومكتب الخصوصية | [90 يوماً] | قبول موثق للمخاطر وضوابط تعويضية |
| استثناء متعلق بالأمن | أمن المعلومات ومكتب الخصوصية | [90 يوماً] | تقييم مخاطر أمني ومراقبة |
| استثناء لمعالجة طرف ثالث | المشتريات ومكتب الخصوصية والإدارة القانونية | [180 يوماً] | ضوابط تعاقدية وخطة معالجة موثقة |
| استثناء لنقل البيانات خارج المملكة | مكتب الخصوصية والإدارة القانونية والراعي التنفيذي | [180 يوماً] | تقييم النقل والضمانات وسجل الاعتماد |
| استثناء للاحتفاظ | مالك السجلات ومكتب الخصوصية والإدارة القانونية | [سنة واحدة] | أساس نظامي ووصول مقيد وتاريخ مراجعة |

Exceptions shall not be used to bypass privacy rights, avoid required notifications, process Personal Data for undisclosed purposes, collect unnecessary Sensitive Personal Data, or transfer Personal Data outside approved safeguards. Expired exceptions shall be closed, renewed through formal approval, or remediated.

---

يجب أن تكون الاستثناءات من هذه السياسة محدودة وموثقة وخاضعة لتقييم المخاطر ومعتمدة قبل التنفيذ، ما لم يكن الإجراء العاجل ضرورياً لحماية الأفراد أو الأنظمة أو المصالح القانونية أو السلامة العامة.

يجب أن يتضمن طلب الاستثناء:

- المتطلب المحدد من السياسة المطلوب الاستثناء منه.
- المبرر التجاري أو النظامي أو التقني أو التشغيلي.
- فئات البيانات الشخصية المتأثرة.
- عدد ونوع أصحاب البيانات المتأثرين.
- غرض المعالجة ومدتها.
- المخاطر على أصحاب البيانات وعلى [اسم الجهة].
- الضوابط والضمانات التعويضية.
- تاريخ انتهاء الاستثناء المقترح.
- موافقات مالك العملية المعني، ومكتب الخصوصية، وأمن المعلومات، والإدارة القانونية عند الاقتضاء.

لا يجوز استخدام الاستثناءات لتجاوز حقوق الخصوصية، أو تجنب الإخطارات المطلوبة، أو معالجة البيانات الشخصية لأغراض غير معلنة، أو جمع بيانات شخصية حساسة غير ضرورية، أو نقل البيانات الشخصية خارج الضمانات المعتمدة. ويجب إغلاق الاستثناءات المنتهية أو تجديدها من خلال اعتماد رسمي أو معالجتها.

## Review & Maintenance

This Policy shall be reviewed at least annually and whenever there is a material change to:

- Applicable privacy or data protection requirements.
- [Organisation Name]’s products, services, systems or business model.
- Personal Data Processing purposes, categories or volumes.
- Data-sharing arrangements, Processors or business partners.
- International transfer arrangements.
- Security risks, incidents or privacy complaints.
- Regulatory guidance or enforcement expectations.
- Organisational structure, ownership or accountability.

The Privacy Office shall coordinate the review with Legal, Information Security, relevant Business Owners and other stakeholders. Updates shall be approved by [Approving Authority] and published through appropriate channels.

Version history shall be maintained as follows:

| Version | Date | Summary of Changes | Approved By |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1.0 | [DD Month YYYY] | Initial approved version | [Approver Name / Committee] |

For questions about this Policy or how [Organisation Name] handles Personal Data, contact:

| Contact Purpose | Contact Details |
|---|---|
| Privacy enquiries and Data Subject requests | [privacy@[organisation-domain].com] |
| Complaints | [complaints@[organisation-domain].com] |
| Postal correspondence | [Registered Address, City, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia] |
| Telephone | [Telephone Number] |

---

تتم مراجعة هذه السياسة سنوياً على الأقل، وكلما حدث تغيير جوهري في:

- متطلبات الخصوصية أو حماية البيانات المعمول بها.
- منتجات [اسم الجهة] أو خدماتها أو أنظمتها أو نموذج أعمالها.
- أغراض معالجة البيانات الشخصية أو فئاتها أو أحجامها.
- ترتيبات مشاركة البيانات أو جهات المعالجة أو شركاء الأعمال.
- ترتيبات نقل البيانات خارج المملكة.
- المخاطر الأمنية أو الحوادث أو شكاوى الخصوصية.
- التوجيهات أو التوقعات التنظيمية.
- الهيكل التنظيمي أو الملكية أو المساءلة.

يتولى مكتب الخصوصية تنسيق المراجعة مع الإدارة القانونية وأمن المعلومات ومالكي العمليات المعنيين وأصحاب المصلحة الآخرين. وتعتمد التحديثات من قبل [جهة الاعتماد] وتنشر عبر القنوات المناسبة.

يتم الاحتفاظ بسجل الإصدارات كما يلي:

| الإصدار | التاريخ | ملخص التغييرات | المعتمد |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1.0 | [يوم شهر سنة] | النسخة الأولية المعتمدة | [اسم المعتمد / اللجنة] |

للاستفسارات حول هذه السياسة أو كيفية تعامل [اسم الجهة] مع البيانات الشخصية، يمكن التواصل عبر:

| غرض التواصل | بيانات التواصل |
|---|---|
| استفسارات الخصوصية وطلبات أصحاب البيانات | [privacy@[organisation-domain].com] |
| الشكاوى | [complaints@[organisation-domain].com] |
| المراسلات البريدية | [العنوان المسجل، المدينة، المملكة العربية السعودية] |
| الهاتف | [رقم الهاتف] |

PDPL-013.title: Internal Data Protection Policy
PDPL-013.content:
| Document ID | Version | Owner | Effective Date | Framework | Classification |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| [POL-DP-001] | 1.0 | [Data Protection Officer / Privacy Office] | [DD Month YYYY] | Saudi Personal Data Protection Law | Internal |

## Purpose

This Internal Data Protection Policy establishes mandatory organisation-wide requirements for protecting personal data in accordance with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law and its Implementing Regulations.

The purpose of this Policy is to ensure that [Organisation Name]:

- Processes personal data lawfully, fairly, transparently, and only for legitimate purposes.
- Protects the privacy rights of individuals whose personal data is processed.
- Applies appropriate governance, security, retention, disclosure, transfer, and accountability controls.
- Demonstrates responsible handling of personal data throughout its lifecycle.
- Ensures employees, contractors, service providers, and business units understand their obligations when processing personal data.

## Scope

This Policy applies to:

- All employees, directors, officers, temporary workers, interns, consultants, contractors, and third parties acting on behalf of [Organisation Name].
- All business units, subsidiaries, branches, functions, projects, and systems operated by or for [Organisation Name].
- All personal data processed by [Organisation Name], whether in electronic, paper, audio, visual, biometric, or any other format.
- All processing activities, including collection, recording, storage, use, analysis, modification, disclosure, transfer, publication, retention, archival, destruction, and anonymisation.
- Personal data relating to customers, employees, job applicants, suppliers, visitors, patients, users, beneficiaries, business contacts, shareholders, and any other identifiable individuals.

For this Policy:

- **Personal data** means any data, regardless of form or source, that identifies an individual directly or indirectly.
- **Sensitive personal data** includes data revealing or relating to matters such as health, genetic or biometric identity, religious belief, security status, financial and credit information, location data where sensitive in context, and other data requiring heightened protection.
- **Data subject** means the individual to whom personal data relates.
- **Controller** means the entity that determines the purpose and method of processing personal data.
- **Processor** means an entity that processes personal data on behalf of a controller.
- **Processing** means any operation performed on personal data.

## Policy Statements

1. **Accountability and Governance**

 1.1. [Organisation Name] shall establish and maintain a data protection governance framework that assigns clear accountability for personal data protection across the organisation.

 1.2. [Organisation Name] shall maintain documented policies, standards, procedures, registers, and evidence demonstrating compliance with this Policy and applicable data protection obligations.

 1.3. Business owners shall be accountable for ensuring that personal data processed within their functions complies with this Policy.

 1.4. Personal data protection requirements shall be embedded into business processes, technology projects, product development, procurement, outsourcing, marketing, human resources, security, and records management activities.

 1.5. Decisions involving significant personal data processing risks shall be documented and approved by appropriate management and the Data Protection Officer or Privacy Office.

2. **Lawful Basis and Legitimate Purpose**

 2.1. [Organisation Name] shall process personal data only where there is a lawful and legitimate basis to do so.

 2.2. Personal data shall be collected and processed only for specific, clear, and lawful purposes that are directly related to [Organisation Name]’s activities.

 2.3. Personal data shall not be processed in a manner incompatible with the purpose for which it was collected unless a valid legal basis exists and required notices, approvals, or safeguards are in place.

 2.4. Where consent is used as the legal basis for processing, consent shall be freely given, specific, informed, documented, and capable of being withdrawn.

 2.5. The organisation shall not make service access conditional on consent to unrelated processing unless such consent is genuinely necessary for providing the service.

 2.6. Processing shall be limited to the minimum personal data necessary to achieve the approved purpose.

3. **Transparency and Privacy Notices**

 3.1. [Organisation Name] shall provide clear privacy notices to data subjects before or at the time personal data is collected, unless a lawful exception applies.

 3.2. Privacy notices shall be written in clear and accessible language appropriate to the audience.

 3.3. Privacy notices shall explain, at a minimum:

 | Required Notice Element | Policy Requirement |
 |---|---|
 | Identity of the controller | The notice shall identify [Organisation Name] and provide relevant contact details. |
 | Purpose of processing | The notice shall describe why personal data is collected and used. |
 | Categories of personal data | The notice shall identify the types of personal data processed. |
 | Collection method | The notice shall state whether data is collected directly or from another source. |
 | Legal basis | The notice shall explain the basis relied upon for processing. |
 | Recipients | The notice shall describe categories of recipients or third parties with whom data may be shared. |
 | International transfer | The notice shall state whether personal data may be transferred outside Saudi Arabia. |
 | Retention period | The notice shall describe how long data will be kept or how retention is determined. |
 | Data subject rights | The notice shall explain available rights and how to exercise them. |
 | Complaint channel | The notice shall provide a method to raise concerns or complaints. |

 3.4. Privacy notices shall be reviewed whenever there is a material change to processing purposes, data categories, recipients, transfer arrangements, or retention periods.

4. **Collection of Personal Data**

 4.1. Personal data shall be collected directly from the data subject wherever practical and appropriate.

 4.2. Where personal data is collected from another source, [Organisation Name] shall ensure that collection is lawful, necessary, and supported by appropriate transparency measures.

 4.3. Personal data shall not be collected by deceptive, misleading, or unlawful means.

 4.4. Business units shall not create new forms, applications, portals, surveys, campaigns, or onboarding processes that collect personal data without completing required privacy review steps.

 4.5. Mandatory and optional data fields shall be clearly distinguished where practical.

 4.6. The organisation shall avoid collecting national identity, financial, health, biometric, children’s, or other sensitive personal data unless clearly necessary and approved.

5. **Use, Access, and Internal Disclosure**

 5.1. Personal data shall be used only by authorised individuals who require access for an approved business purpose.

 5.2. Access to personal data shall be granted based on least privilege and role-based access principles.

 5.3. Personal data shall not be accessed, browsed, copied, exported, photographed, downloaded, or shared for personal interest, curiosity, convenience, or any unauthorised purpose.

 5.4. Internal disclosure of personal data between departments shall occur only where there is a legitimate business need and the receiving department is authorised to process the data.

 5.5. Bulk extraction, reporting, analytics, profiling, or automated decision-making involving personal data shall be subject to privacy review and approval.

 5.6. Production personal data shall not be used in development, testing, training, or demonstration environments unless approved safeguards are applied, such as anonymisation, masking, or strong access restrictions.

6. **Sensitive Personal Data**

 6.1. Sensitive personal data shall be processed only where strictly necessary, lawful, and approved by the relevant business owner and the Data Protection Officer or Privacy Office.

 6.2. Processing of sensitive personal data shall be subject to enhanced safeguards, including stricter access controls, encryption where appropriate, monitoring, retention limits, and documented justification.

 6.3. Health, biometric, genetic, financial, identity, security status, and children’s data shall not be processed without a documented business need and privacy risk assessment.

 6.4. Sensitive personal data shall not be disclosed externally unless authorised by law, required for an approved purpose, or supported by valid consent or another lawful basis.

 6.5. Special care shall be applied where processing could result in discrimination, financial harm, reputational harm, denial of services, physical risk, or significant intrusion into private life.

7. **Children’s and Vulnerable Individuals’ Data**

 7.1. Personal data relating to children or vulnerable individuals shall be processed with heightened care and only where necessary for a lawful and legitimate purpose.

 7.2. Where consent is required for processing children’s data, appropriate consent shall be obtained from a parent, guardian, or legally authorised representative where applicable.

 7.3. Privacy notices and consent language intended for children or guardians shall be clear, age-appropriate where relevant, and easy to understand.

 7.4. Marketing, profiling, behavioural tracking, or automated decisions involving children’s personal data shall require prior privacy review and senior approval.

8. **Consent Management**

 8.1. Consent shall be obtained before processing personal data where consent is the required or selected legal basis.

 8.2. Consent requests shall clearly state the processing purpose, data categories, whether data will be shared, and how consent can be withdrawn.

 8.3. Consent shall not be bundled with unrelated terms or obtained through silence, pre-ticked boxes, inactivity, or ambiguous wording.

 8.4. Records of consent shall be maintained, including who consented, when consent was obtained, what information was provided, and the method used.

 8.5. Withdrawal of consent shall be as easy as giving consent and shall be actioned without undue delay.

 8.6. Withdrawal of consent shall not affect processing lawfully carried out before withdrawal, but further processing based on that consent shall stop unless another lawful basis applies.

 | Consent Activity | Minimum Record Required |
 |---|---|
 | Consent obtained | Data subject identity, date/time, channel, purpose, notice version, consent wording |
 | Consent changed | Previous preference, new preference, date/time, channel |
 | Consent withdrawn | Withdrawal date/time, affected processing activity, confirmation of action taken |
 | Consent evidence requested | Requestor, evidence provided, date/time, approval where required |

9. **Data Subject Rights**

 9.1. [Organisation Name] shall enable data subjects to exercise their rights in relation to their personal data.

 9.2. Data subjects shall be provided with accessible channels to submit privacy rights requests.

 9.3. The organisation shall verify the identity of the requestor before disclosing, correcting, deleting, or otherwise acting on personal data.

 9.4. Requests shall be handled within applicable legal timelines and without unnecessary delay.

 9.5. The organisation shall provide clear responses to data subjects, including reasons where a request is refused or only partially fulfilled.

 9.6. Data subject rights shall include, as applicable:

 | Right | Policy Requirement |
 |---|---|
 | Right to be informed | Individuals shall receive clear information about how their personal data is processed. |
 | Right of access | Individuals shall be able to request access to their personal data held by the organisation. |
 | Right to obtain a copy | Individuals shall be able to request a copy of their personal data in an appropriate format where permitted. |
 | Right to correction | Individuals shall be able to request correction, completion, or updating of inaccurate or incomplete data. |
 | Right to deletion | Individuals shall be able to request deletion where retention is no longer lawful or necessary, subject to legal obligations. |
 | Right to withdraw consent | Individuals shall be able to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent. |
 | Right to complain | Individuals shall be able to raise privacy concerns through the organisation’s designated channels. |

 9.7. Data subject rights requests shall be recorded in a central register.

 | Request Handling Step | Target Timeline |
 |---|---:|
 | Acknowledge receipt | Within [5 business days] |
 | Verify identity | Within [10 business days] |
 | Assess request and applicable limitations | Within [15 business days] |
 | Complete response | Within [30 calendar days] unless an approved extension applies |
 | Escalate complex or high-risk request | Immediately upon identification |

10. **Accuracy and Data Quality**

 10.1. Personal data shall be accurate, complete, and kept up to date where necessary for the processing purpose.

 10.2. Business units shall implement reasonable checks to ensure the quality of personal data collected or maintained.

 10.3. Inaccurate or outdated personal data shall be corrected, updated, restricted, or deleted as appropriate.

 10.4. Where inaccurate personal data has been disclosed to a third party, reasonable steps shall be taken to notify the third party of the correction where appropriate.

11. **Retention and Disposal**

 11.1. Personal data shall be retained only for as long as necessary to fulfil the approved purpose, meet legal or contractual obligations, resolve disputes, enforce rights, or support legitimate operational needs.

 11.2. Retention periods shall be documented in an approved retention schedule.

 11.3. Personal data shall not be kept indefinitely “just in case” or for undefined future use.

 11.4. Where retention is no longer justified, personal data shall be securely deleted, destroyed, anonymised, or archived in accordance with approved records management requirements.

 11.5. Disposal of personal data shall be performed using secure methods appropriate to the format and sensitivity of the data.

 | Data Type | Example Minimum Retention Control |
 |---|---|
 | Customer account data | Retain according to contractual, legal, and service requirements, then securely delete or anonymise. |
 | Employee records | Retain according to labour, payroll, tax, and legal requirements, then securely dispose. |
 | CCTV footage | Retain for a limited operational security period unless required for investigation or legal hold. |
 | Marketing preferences | Retain while active and as needed to evidence consent or opt-out status. |
 | Incident records | Retain according to legal, audit, and risk management requirements. |
 | Identity documents | Retain only where required and for the shortest justified period. |

 11.6. Legal holds, investigations, audits, or regulatory requirements may suspend normal deletion where formally approved.

12. **Security of Personal Data**

 12.1. [Organisation Name] shall implement appropriate technical, organisational, and physical security measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, misuse, alteration, disclosure, destruction, or damage.

 12.2. Security measures shall be proportionate to the sensitivity, volume, context, and risk of processing.

 12.3. Personal data security controls shall include, as appropriate:

 - Role-based access controls.
 - Strong authentication.
 - Encryption in transit and at rest.
 - Secure configuration and hardening.
 - Logging and monitoring.
 - Data loss prevention.
 - Backup and recovery controls.
 - Network segmentation.
 - Endpoint protection.
 - Physical access controls.
 - Secure disposal.
 - Vulnerability and patch management.
 - User access reviews.
 - Privileged access management.

 12.4. Personal data shall be transmitted only through approved secure channels.

 12.5. Personal data shall not be stored on unauthorised personal devices, removable media, consumer cloud services, personal email accounts, or unmanaged messaging platforms.

 12.6. Access to systems containing personal data shall be reviewed periodically and promptly removed when no longer required.

13. **Privacy by Design and Privacy by Default**

 13.1. Privacy requirements shall be considered at the earliest stage of any new product, service, system, process, vendor engagement, analytics initiative, or business change involving personal data.

 13.2. New or changed processing activities shall undergo privacy review before implementation.

 13.3. Systems and processes shall be designed to collect the least amount of personal data necessary, restrict access by default, retain data only as needed, and provide appropriate transparency.

 13.4. Default settings shall favour privacy protection and shall not expose personal data more broadly than necessary.

 13.5. Project teams shall not launch processing activities until required privacy risks, notices, consents, contracts, security controls, and retention requirements are addressed.

14. **Privacy Impact and Risk Assessments**

 14.1. Privacy risk assessments shall be conducted for processing activities that may create elevated risk to individuals or the organisation.

 14.2. A privacy impact assessment shall be required for activities involving, as applicable:

 - Sensitive personal data.
 - Children’s data.
 - Large-scale processing.
 - Automated decision-making or profiling.
 - Biometrics, health, genetic, or financial data.
 - Systematic monitoring or tracking.
 - New technologies.
 - Cross-border transfer.
 - High-volume data sharing.
 - Processing likely to significantly affect individuals’ rights or interests.

 14.3. Privacy impact assessments shall document the processing purpose, data categories, legal basis, data flows, risks, controls, residual risks, and approvals.

 14.4. High residual privacy risks shall be escalated to senior management and the Data Protection Officer or Privacy Office before processing begins.

15. **Records of Processing Activities**

 15.1. [Organisation Name] shall maintain an inventory of personal data processing activities.

 15.2. Business owners shall ensure that processing records for their functions are complete, accurate, and updated when changes occur.

 15.3. The processing inventory shall include, at a minimum:

 | Processing Record Field | Required Content |
 |---|---|
 | Business owner | Accountable function or process owner |
 | Processing purpose | Why personal data is processed |
 | Data subject categories | Whose data is processed |
 | Personal data categories | Types of personal data involved |
 | Sensitive data indicator | Whether sensitive data is processed |
 | Source of data | Direct or third-party source |
 | Legal basis | Basis relied upon for processing |
 | Systems and repositories | Where data is stored or processed |
 | Recipients | Internal and external recipients |
 | Processors | Vendors processing data on behalf of the organisation |
 | Transfer locations | Countries where data is accessed, stored, or transferred |
 | Retention period | Approved retention requirement |
 | Security controls | Key safeguards applied |
 | Privacy notice | Notice or communication used |
 | Risk assessment status | Assessment completed or required |

16. **Third-Party Processing and Data Sharing**

 16.1. Personal data shall be shared with third parties only where there is a lawful purpose, appropriate approval, and documented safeguards.

 16.2. Third parties processing personal data on behalf of [Organisation Name] shall be assessed before engagement and monitored throughout the relationship.

 16.3. Contracts with processors shall include data protection obligations appropriate to the processing, including:

 - Processing only on documented instructions.
 - Confidentiality obligations.
 - Security requirements.
 - Limits on subcontracting.
 - Assistance with data subject rights.
 - Breach notification obligations.
 - Return or deletion of personal data at contract end.
 - Audit, assurance, and monitoring rights.
 - Restrictions on international transfers.
 - Requirements to comply with applicable data protection law.

 16.4. Third parties shall not use personal data provided by [Organisation Name] for their own purposes unless authorised by contract, law, and applicable transparency requirements.

 16.5. Data sharing with independent controllers shall be governed by appropriate agreements or approved documented arrangements.

 16.6. Procurement and vendor onboarding processes shall include privacy and security due diligence for vendors that process personal data.

17. **International Transfers**

 17.1. Personal data shall not be transferred, stored, accessed, or otherwise processed outside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia unless the transfer is lawful, necessary, approved, and subject to required safeguards.

 17.2. International transfers shall be reviewed by the Data Protection Officer or Privacy Office before execution.

 17.3. Transfer assessments shall consider the purpose of transfer, destination country, recipient, data categories, sensitivity, onward transfers, security safeguards, contractual protections, and risks to data subjects.

 17.4. International transfers shall be limited to the minimum personal data necessary for the approved purpose.

 17.5. Contracts and technical controls shall be used to protect personal data transferred internationally.

 17.6. Cloud hosting, remote support, offshore development, global HR systems, international customer support, and multinational analytics platforms shall be treated as international transfers where personal data is accessed or stored outside Saudi Arabia.

 17.7. Business units shall not configure systems, integrations, backups, support access, or storage locations in a way that creates an unapproved international transfer.

18. **Personal Data Breach Management**

 18.1. [Organisation Name] shall maintain a documented process for identifying, reporting, assessing, containing, investigating, and remediating personal data breaches.

 18.2. All workforce members shall immediately report suspected or confirmed personal data breaches through approved incident reporting channels.

 18.3. Personal data breaches may include:

 - Email sent to the wrong recipient.
 - Lost or stolen laptop, mobile device, document, or storage media.
 - Unauthorised access to a system containing personal data.
 - Ransomware or malware affecting personal data.
 - Accidental publication of personal data.
 - Unauthorised disclosure to a vendor, employee, or external party.
 - Loss of availability or integrity of personal data.
 - Misconfigured cloud storage or exposed database.
 - Unauthorised data extraction or scraping.

 18.4. The organisation shall assess whether a breach requires notification to the competent authority, affected individuals, customers, partners, or other stakeholders.

 18.5. Notifications shall be made within applicable legal timelines and shall include accurate, clear, and complete information available at the time.

 18.6. Breach investigations shall document facts, affected data, root cause, containment actions, risk assessment, notifications, remediation, and lessons learned.

 | Breach Activity | Target Timeline |
 |---|---:|
 | Internal report by employee or contractor | Immediately upon discovery |
 | Initial triage by Security or Privacy team | Within [24 hours] |
 | Containment actions initiated | As soon as practicable |
 | Privacy impact assessment | Within [48 hours] of triage where personal data is involved |
 | Authority notification decision | Within the required notification window |
 | Individual notification decision | As soon as risk to individuals is understood |
 | Post-incident review | Within [10 business days] after closure |

19. **Marketing, Communications, and Public Disclosure**

 19.1. Direct marketing using personal data shall be conducted only where lawful, transparent, and supported by valid consent or another approved basis.

 19.2. Marketing communications shall include a clear and simple method to opt out or withdraw consent.

 19.3. Marketing preference records shall be maintained and respected across relevant systems and channels.

 19.4. Personal data shall not be published publicly, including on websites, social media, press releases, directories, or public reports, unless lawful, necessary, approved, and supported by appropriate notice or consent where required.

 19.5. Employee photographs, biographies, contact details, customer testimonials, case studies, and event images shall be published only after appropriate review and approval.

20. **Automated Processing, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence**

 20.1. Automated processing, profiling, analytics, artificial intelligence, or machine learning involving personal data shall be subject to privacy review before deployment.

 20.2. Such processing shall be explainable at an appropriate level, fair, proportionate, and aligned with the stated purpose.

 20.3. Personal data used for analytics or model training shall be minimised, anonymised, pseudonymised, or aggregated where practical.

 20.4. Automated decisions that may significantly affect individuals shall include appropriate human oversight, safeguards, and channels for review or challenge where applicable.

 20.5. Personal data shall not be entered into public or unapproved artificial intelligence tools unless explicitly approved and protected by appropriate contractual, security, and privacy controls.

21. **Anonymisation and Pseudonymisation**

 21.1. Anonymisation shall be used where business objectives can be achieved without identifiable personal data.

 21.2. Anonymised data shall be processed in a manner that prevents re-identification using reasonably available means.

 21.3. Pseudonymised data shall remain subject to this Policy where re-identification is possible.

 21.4. Re-identification of anonymised or pseudonymised data shall be prohibited unless formally approved for a lawful and necessary purpose.

22. **Employee and HR Personal Data**

 22.1. Employee and applicant personal data shall be processed only for legitimate employment, recruitment, workforce management, legal, security, payroll, benefits, health and safety, and operational purposes.

 22.2. Employee monitoring shall be proportionate, transparent where appropriate, and limited to legitimate business, legal, security, or compliance purposes.

 22.3. Access to employee personal data shall be restricted to authorised HR, management, finance, legal, security, and administrative personnel with a genuine need to know.

 22.4. Background screening, medical checks, disciplinary records, performance data, and payroll data shall be subject to enhanced confidentiality and access controls.

23. **Training and Awareness**

 23.1. All employees and contractors shall complete data protection awareness training appropriate to their role.

 23.2. Personnel with elevated access to personal data or responsibility for high-risk processing shall receive additional role-based training.

 23.3. Training shall cover lawful processing, privacy notices, consent, data subject rights, breach reporting, secure handling, retention, third-party sharing, and international transfer restrictions.

 23.4. Training completion shall be tracked and reported to management.

 23.5. Failure to complete required training may result in access restrictions or disciplinary action.

24. **Confidentiality**

 24.1. Workforce members shall protect personal data as confidential information.

 24.2. Confidentiality obligations shall continue after employment or engagement with [Organisation Name] ends.

 24.3. Personal data shall be discussed, displayed, printed, transported, or stored only in a manner that prevents unauthorised viewing, access, or disclosure.

25. **Documentation and Evidence**

 25.1. [Organisation Name] shall retain evidence of compliance with this Policy, including approvals, assessments, notices, consent records, contracts, training records, incident records, data subject request logs, transfer assessments, and audit results.

 25.2. Evidence shall be accurate, retrievable, protected from unauthorised alteration, and retained according to approved retention requirements.

 25.3. Business units shall provide requested data protection evidence to the Data Protection Officer, Privacy Office, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, or authorised regulators when required.

## Roles & Responsibilities

| Role | Responsibilities |
|---|---|
| Board of Directors / Governing Body | Provide oversight of data protection governance, approve strategic direction, and ensure sufficient resources are available for compliance. |
| Executive Management | Promote a culture of privacy, ensure business functions comply with this Policy, and resolve escalated privacy risks. |
| Data Protection Officer / Privacy Office | Maintain this Policy, advise the organisation on data protection obligations, review high-risk processing, oversee rights requests and breach response, maintain privacy registers, and monitor compliance. |
| Legal Department | Advise on legal basis, notices, contracts, disclosures, regulatory engagement, disputes, and legal holds involving personal data. |
| Information Security | Implement and monitor technical and organisational security controls protecting personal data, support breach response, and conduct security risk assessments. |
| Compliance / Risk Management | Support monitoring, risk assessment, regulatory alignment, issue tracking, and reporting. |
| Internal Audit | Independently assess the effectiveness of data protection governance, controls, and compliance evidence. |
| Records Management | Maintain retention schedules and ensure secure archival, deletion, destruction, and legal hold practices. |
| Procurement / Vendor Management | Ensure privacy and security due diligence is performed before engaging vendors that process personal data and that required contractual protections are in place. |
| Human Resources | Protect employee and applicant personal data, deliver workforce privacy training, and support disciplinary action for violations. |
| Business Owners | Own processing activities within their functions, maintain accurate processing records, ensure privacy reviews are completed, and implement required controls. |
| System Owners | Ensure systems processing personal data have approved access, security, logging, retention, backup, and deletion controls. |
| Project Managers / Product Owners | Embed privacy requirements into new and changed processes, products, services, and technologies before launch. |
| Employees and Contractors | Process personal data only as authorised, complete training, follow this Policy, protect data from unauthorised disclosure, and immediately report suspected incidents. |
| Third-Party Processors | Process personal data only as authorised by contract, protect personal data, notify incidents promptly, support rights requests, and comply with agreed data protection obligations. |

## Compliance, Monitoring & Enforcement

1. Compliance with this Policy is mandatory for all personnel and applicable third parties.

2. [Organisation Name] shall monitor compliance through appropriate activities, including:

 - Privacy reviews.
 - Processing inventory reviews.
 - Vendor assessments.
 - Access reviews.
 - Security monitoring.
 - Data subject request quality checks.
 - Breach response testing.
 - Training completion tracking.
 - Internal audits.
 - Control self-assessments.
 - Retention and disposal reviews.
 - International transfer reviews.

3. The Data Protection Officer or Privacy Office shall report significant data protection risks, incidents, compliance gaps, and remediation status to executive management and other governance forums as appropriate.

4. Business owners shall remediate identified privacy gaps within agreed timeframes.

5. Where remediation cannot be completed on time, the business owner shall document the reason, interim controls, risk acceptance request, and revised completion date.

6. Violations of this Policy may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment or contract, civil or legal action, suspension of system access, vendor remediation, contract termination, and regulatory notification where required.

7. Examples of violations include:

 - Accessing personal data without a business need.
 - Sharing personal data with an unauthorised recipient.
 - Using personal data for an unapproved purpose.
 - Ignoring consent or opt-out preferences.
 - Failing to report a suspected breach.
 - Storing personal data in unauthorised tools or locations.
 - Transferring personal data outside Saudi Arabia without approval.
 - Retaining personal data beyond approved retention periods.
 - Engaging a processor without privacy review and contract controls.
 - Circumventing security or privacy controls.

8. Compliance evidence shall be retained and made available to authorised internal and external reviewers when required.

## Exceptions

1. Exceptions to this Policy shall be permitted only where there is a documented business, legal, technical, or operational justification.

2. Exceptions shall not be used to bypass mandatory legal requirements or create unjustified risk to individuals.

3. All exception requests shall be submitted to the Data Protection Officer or Privacy Office using the approved exception process.

4. Exception requests shall include:

 | Exception Field | Required Information |
 |---|---|
 | Requestor | Name, role, department, and contact details |
 | Policy requirement affected | Description of the requirement from which exception is requested |
 | Business justification | Reason the exception is needed |
 | Personal data involved | Categories, volume, sensitivity, and data subjects affected |
 | Risk assessment | Potential impact to individuals and the organisation |
 | Compensating controls | Measures to reduce risk during the exception period |
 | Duration | Requested start date and end date |
 | Approvals | Business owner, Data Protection Officer or Privacy Office, Information Security where applicable, and senior management where required |

5. Approved exceptions shall be time-bound, risk-assessed, documented, and reviewed periodically.

6. Exceptions involving high-risk processing, sensitive personal data, international transfers, or breach notification obligations shall require senior management approval.

7. Expired exceptions shall be treated as non-compliance unless renewed through the approved process.

## Review & Maintenance

1. This Policy shall be reviewed at least annually and whenever significant changes occur in legal requirements, regulatory guidance, business operations, technology, risk profile, processing activities, or organisational structure.

2. The Data Protection Officer or Privacy Office is responsible for coordinating review and maintenance of this Policy.

3. Policy updates shall be reviewed by relevant stakeholders, including Legal, Information Security, Compliance, Risk Management, Human Resources, Procurement, Records Management, and affected business units.

4. Material changes to this Policy shall be approved by [Approving Authority].

5. The current approved version of this Policy shall be published in [Policy Repository / Intranet Location].

6. Superseded versions shall be retained according to document control and records management requirements.

7. Business units shall update related procedures, notices, forms, contracts, training, and system controls following changes to this Policy.

PDPL-014.title: Data Retention & Destruction Policy
PDPL-014.content:
| Document ID | Version | Owner | Effective Date | Framework | Classification |
|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| [POL-PRIV-RET-001] | 1.0 | Data Protection Officer / Privacy Office | [Effective Date] | Saudi Personal Data Protection Law | Internal |

## Purpose

This Data Retention & Destruction Policy establishes mandatory requirements for retaining, archiving, and securely destroying personal data processed by [Organisation Name]. It ensures that personal data is kept only for lawful, specified, and necessary purposes, and that it is securely disposed of when no longer required.

This Policy supports [Organisation Name] in meeting its obligations under the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law and its implementing requirements, including obligations relating to data minimisation, storage limitation, security of personal data, data subject rights, breach prevention, and accountability.

The objectives of this Policy are to:

- Define how long personal data shall be retained for business, legal, regulatory, contractual, and operational purposes.
- Prevent indefinite or unjustified storage of personal data.
- Ensure retention periods are documented, approved, and consistently applied.
- Ensure personal data is securely destroyed, anonymised, or archived when retention is no longer justified.
- Support timely fulfilment of data subject requests, regulatory inquiries, litigation holds, investigations, audits, and business continuity needs.
- Reduce privacy, cybersecurity, legal, and operational risks arising from excessive or unmanaged data retention.

## Scope

This Policy applies to:

- All employees, contractors, consultants, temporary staff, interns, secondees, and third parties who process personal data on behalf of [Organisation Name].
- All personal data collected, used, stored, shared, archived, backed up, or destroyed by [Organisation Name], whether in electronic, physical, audio, visual, or other formats.
- Personal data relating to customers, employees, job applicants, visitors, vendors, business contacts, website users, beneficiaries, patients, students, shareholders, or any other identifiable individual.
- Sensitive personal data, including health data, biometric data, genetic data, financial data, location data, religious or belief-related data, security-related data, and other categories requiring heightened protection.
- All systems, applications, databases, file shares, collaboration platforms, cloud environments, mobile devices, endpoint devices, physical records, archives, logs, backups, removable media, and third-party systems where personal data is stored or processed.
- All stages of the personal data lifecycle, including collection, creation, use, storage, transfer, archival, retention review, anonymisation, deletion, destruction, and disposal.

This Policy applies to all business units, subsidiaries, branches, and controlled entities of [Organisation Name] operating in or processing personal data subject to Saudi personal data protection requirements.

Where local legal, regulatory, or contractual obligations require a longer retention period than this Policy, the longer period shall apply. Where there is a conflict between retention obligations, the matter shall be escalated to the Data Protection Officer, Legal, and Records Management for resolution.

## Policy Statements

1. **Retention shall be lawful, necessary, and proportionate.** 
 1.1. [Organisation Name] shall retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the specific purpose for which it was collected or subsequently processed. 
 1.2. Personal data shall not be retained indefinitely unless there is a valid legal, regulatory, contractual, archival, evidentiary, or legitimate business requirement approved by the Data Protection Officer and Legal. 
 1.3. Retention periods shall be aligned with the nature of the personal data, the processing purpose, the sensitivity of the data, applicable legal requirements, contractual obligations, and the risk to individuals.

2. **Retention purposes shall be defined and documented.** 
 2.1. Each business process that stores personal data shall have a documented retention purpose.
