SOX-013.title: Segregation of Duties (SoD) Matrix
SOX-013.content:
## Segregation of Duties (SoD) Matrix (XLSX template)

_Editable template — add your own rows. The example row(s) below are placeholders to replace._

| SoD Conflict ID | Business Process | SOX In-Scope Application | Application/System ID | Conflict Scenario | Role/Entitlement A | Role/Entitlement A Description | Role/Entitlement B | Role/Entitlement B Description | Conflict Type | Risk Description | SOX Financial Statement Risk | Risk Rating | Incompatible Role Combination Allowed? | Mitigating Control Required? | Mitigating Control ID | Mitigating Control Description | Mitigating Control Owner | Mitigating Control Frequency | Mitigating Control Evidence | Preventive or Detective | Compensating Control Effectiveness Rating | Access Request Control Reference | User Access Review Control Reference | Privileged Access Control Reference | Exception Approval Required? | Exception Approver Role | Exception Approval Evidence Location | Remediation Action Required? | Remediation Action Description | Remediation Owner | Target Remediation Date | Current Status | Last Reviewed Date | Reviewed By | Next Review Due Date | Comments |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [EXAMPLE: SOD-001] | [EXAMPLE: Procure-to-Pay] | [EXAMPLE: SAP ECC] | [EXAMPLE: APP-SAP-001] | [EXAMPLE: User can create or change vendor master data and release vendor payments] | [EXAMPLE: SAP_AP_VENDOR_MAINTAIN] | [EXAMPLE: Allows creation and modification of supplier master records including bank details] | [EXAMPLE: SAP_AP_PAYMENT_RELEASE] | [EXAMPLE: Allows approval or release of vendor payment runs] | [EXAMPLE: Create/Pay] | [EXAMPLE: A user could create a fictitious vendor or change bank details and release an unauthorized payment] | [EXAMPLE: Unauthorized or invalid cash disbursement impacting completeness, accuracy, and validity of expenses and liabilities] | [EXAMPLE: High] | [EXAMPLE: Yes] | [EXAMPLE: Yes] | [EXAMPLE: AP-MC-004] | [EXAMPLE: AP Manager reviews monthly vendor change report matched to payment release activity and investigates users appearing on both reports] | [EXAMPLE: AP Manager] | [EXAMPLE: Monthly] | [EXAMPLE: Signed monthly vendor change/payment release review report stored in SOX evidence repository] | [EXAMPLE: Detective] | [EXAMPLE: Effective] | [EXAMPLE: ITGC-AC-01] | [EXAMPLE: ITGC-AC-03] | [EXAMPLE: N/A] | [EXAMPLE: Yes] | [EXAMPLE: Finance Controller] | [EXAMPLE: GRC request ID or SOX evidence repository path] | [EXAMPLE: Yes] | [EXAMPLE: Remove payment release access unless approved exception is renewed] | [EXAMPLE: IAM Team] | [EXAMPLE: 2026-03-31] | [EXAMPLE: Active] | [EXAMPLE: 2026-01-15] | [EXAMPLE: Jane Smith, SOX ITGC Control Owner] | [EXAMPLE: 2026-04-15] | [EXAMPLE: Exception only permitted for backup AP supervisor role] |
| [EXAMPLE: SOD-002] | [EXAMPLE: Financial Close] | [EXAMPLE: Oracle ERP Cloud] | [EXAMPLE: APP-ORCL-002] | [EXAMPLE: User can post manual journals and approve the same journals] | [EXAMPLE: GL_JOURNAL_ENTRY] | [EXAMPLE: Allows creation and posting of manual journal entries] | [EXAMPLE: GL_JOURNAL_APPROVER] | [EXAMPLE: Allows approval of manual journal entries submitted for posting] | [EXAMPLE: Create/Approve] | [EXAMPLE: A user could create and approve unauthorized or unsupported journal entries without independent review] | [EXAMPLE: Inaccurate financial reporting impacting accuracy, validity, occurrence, and completeness of journal entries] | [EXAMPLE: High] | [EXAMPLE: No] | [EXAMPLE: Yes] | [EXAMPLE: GL-MC-002] | [EXAMPLE: Controller reviews monthly journal entry report for preparer and approver conflicts and validates supporting evidence] | [EXAMPLE: Corporate Controller] | [EXAMPLE: Monthly] | [EXAMPLE: Journal conflict exception report with documented review sign-off] | [EXAMPLE: Detective] | [EXAMPLE: Effective] | [EXAMPLE: ITGC-AC-01] | [EXAMPLE: ITGC-AC-03] | [EXAMPLE: ITGC-AC-05] | [EXAMPLE: Yes] | [EXAMPLE: Corporate Controller] | [EXAMPLE: IAM ticket number and GRC approval workflow] | [EXAMPLE: Yes] | [EXAMPLE: Remove journal approval role from users with journal posting access] | [EXAMPLE: Application Owner] | [EXAMPLE: 2026-02-28] | [EXAMPLE: Remediation In Progress] | [EXAMPLE: 2026-01-10] | [EXAMPLE: John Lee, Oracle Application Owner] | [EXAMPLE: 2026-04-10] | [EXAMPLE: Role redesign pending approval from Finance Systems Governance Board] |

### Column Guidance

| Column | What to enter |
|---|---|
| SoD Conflict ID | Enter a unique identifier for the SoD conflict rule or matrix line item; format recommended as SOD-###, e.g., SOD-001. |
| Business Process | Enter the affected business process; allowed values should align to the organisation’s SOX process inventory, e.g., Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, Payroll, Treasury, Inventory, Financial Close. |
| SOX In-Scope Application | Enter the name of the SOX-relevant application where the conflicting access exists or could exist, e.g., SAP ECC, Oracle ERP, Workday, NetSuite. |
| Application/System ID | Enter the unique application identifier or system code used in the CMDB, GRC tool, IAM platform, or application inventory. |
| Conflict Scenario | Describe the incompatible activity combination in business terms, e.g., ability to create vendors and release vendor payments. |
| Role/Entitlement A | Enter the first role, profile, group, permission, transaction code, duty, or entitlement involved in the conflict exactly as named in the source system. |
| Role/Entitlement A Description | Describe what Role/Entitlement A allows the user to perform, including the key business activity and access level. |
| Role/Entitlement B | Enter the second conflicting role, profile, group, permission, transaction code, duty, or entitlement exactly as named in the source system. |
| Role/Entitlement B Description | Describe what Role/Entitlement B allows the user to perform, including the key business activity and access level. |
| Conflict Type | Select the nature of the SoD issue; allowed values: Create/Approve, Create/Pay, Maintain/Post, Maintain/Approve, Initiate/Release, Develop/Migrate, Admin/Business User, Read/Write Sensitive Data, Other. |
| Risk Description | Describe the risk arising from the combined access, including how fraud, error, unauthorized transaction processing, or unauthorized financial reporting change could occur. |
| SOX Financial Statement Risk | Enter the relevant SOX risk or assertion impacted, e.g., unauthorized transaction, inaccurate financial reporting, completeness, accuracy, validity, occurrence, cut-off, restricted access to financially significant data. |
| Risk Rating | Enter the inherent risk rating for the conflict; allowed values: High, Medium, Low. High should be used where the combination could directly result in unauthorized or misstated financial transactions. |
| Incompatible Role Combination Allowed? | Indicate whether the organisation permits this combination under any circumstance; allowed values: Yes, No. If Yes, mitigating control and approval fields must be completed. |
| Mitigating Control Required? | Indicate whether a mitigating control is required when the conflict exists; allowed values: Yes, No. For SOX-relevant High or Medium conflicts this is normally Yes unless the combination is prohibited. |
| Mitigating Control ID | Enter the formal control reference for the mitigating control, using the SOX control ID format from the control matrix, e.g., ITGC-AC-## or business control ID; enter N/A if no mitigating control is permitted. |
| Mitigating Control Description | Describe the specific mitigating control that detects or prevents misuse of the conflicting access, including what is reviewed, by whom, and what evidence is retained. |
| Mitigating Control Owner | Enter the role or named owner accountable for performing the mitigating control, e.g., AP Manager, Finance Controller, System Owner. |
| Mitigating Control Frequency | Enter how often the mitigating control is performed; allowed values: Real-time, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-Annual, Annual, Event-driven, N/A. |
| Mitigating Control Evidence | Describe the evidence retained to prove the mitigating control operated, e.g., review report, signed approval, workflow log, ticket ID, reconciliation file, exception report. |
| Preventive or Detective | Classify the mitigating control type; allowed values: Preventive, Detective, Both, N/A. |
| Compensating Control Effectiveness Rating | Enter the assessed effectiveness of the mitigating control for this conflict; allowed values: Effective, Partially Effective, Ineffective, Not Assessed, N/A. |
| Access Request Control Reference | Enter the SOX ITGC access provisioning control ID that governs approval before assigning either conflicting role, e.g., ITGC-AC-01. |
| User Access Review Control Reference | Enter the SOX ITGC periodic user access review control ID used to detect inappropriate role combinations, e.g., ITGC-AC-03. |
| Privileged Access Control Reference | Enter the privileged access or administrator access control ID if either role includes elevated access; enter N/A if not applicable. |
| Exception Approval Required? | Indicate whether formal exception approval is required to assign or retain the conflict; allowed values: Yes, No. |
| Exception Approver Role | Enter the required approval role for exceptions, e.g., Business Process Owner, Control Owner, Application Owner, Finance Controller, CISO; enter N/A if exceptions are not allowed. |
| Exception Approval Evidence Location | Enter where approval evidence must be stored, such as GRC workflow ID, IAM request ID, ticket number, SharePoint path, or audit repository location; enter N/A if not applicable. |
| Remediation Action Required? | Indicate whether action is required to remove or reduce the conflict; allowed values: Yes, No. |
| Remediation Action Description | Describe the required action, e.g., remove Role B, redesign role, restrict transaction code, add workflow approval, implement monitoring report; enter N/A if none. |
| Remediation Owner | Enter the role or named individual responsible for remediation, e.g., Application Owner, IAM Team, Role Owner, Business Process Owner; enter N/A if none. |
| Target Remediation Date | Enter the planned completion date for remediation in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter N/A if no remediation is required. |
| Current Status | Enter the current lifecycle status of this SoD matrix line; allowed values: Draft, Active, Under Review, Approved Exception, Remediation In Progress, Retired. |
| Last Reviewed Date | Enter the date this SoD conflict rule was last reviewed and confirmed by the control/application/process owner in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Reviewed By | Enter the name and role of the person who last reviewed this matrix line, e.g., Jane Smith, SOX ITGC Control Owner. |
| Next Review Due Date | Enter the next scheduled review date in YYYY-MM-DD format, based on the required review cadence. |
| Comments | Enter any additional audit-relevant notes, assumptions, linkage to role redesign activities, or rationale for classification; do not use this field as a substitute for required fields. |

### Maintenance

The SoD Matrix is owned by the SOX ITGC Access Control Owner with input from Application Owners, Business Process Owners, IAM, and Internal Controls. It is reviewed at least quarterly and whenever roles, entitlements, SOX in-scope applications, business processes, or mitigating controls change, using source data from the IAM/GRC platform, application role catalogues, user access review results, CMDB/application inventory, and SOX control matrix.

|---|---|
| Review Period | Enter the access review period covered by this listing in format YYYY-Q# or YYYY-MM, e.g. 2026-Q1 or 2026-03. |
| Business Process / SOX Area | Enter the SOX-relevant process supported by the system, e.g. Financial Reporting, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Record to Report, Payroll. |
| Application / System Name | Enter the exact application, database, platform, or infrastructure system name from which the user access listing was extracted. |
| System Environment | Enter the environment covered by the listing; allowed values: Production, Non-Production, DR, Other. |
| Source Report Name | Enter the exact native report, query, table, or export name used to produce the listing. |
| Extraction Date | Enter the date the listing was extracted from the source system in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Extraction Time and Time Zone | Enter the exact extraction time and time zone in HH:MM TZ format, e.g. 14:35 UTC or 09:35 EST. |
| Extracted By | Enter the name or system ID of the person or automation account that generated the listing. |
| User Account ID | Enter the unique login, username, account ID, or system identifier exactly as shown in the source system. |
| User Full Name | Enter the user's full legal or HR name; for service or generic accounts, enter the account display name. |
| Employee / Contractor ID | Enter the unique HR employee ID, contractor ID, vendor ID, or N/A if not applicable. |
| User Email | Enter the user's business email address; for service or generic accounts, enter the mailbox or N/A if none exists. |
| User Type | Enter the account classification; allowed values: Employee, Contractor, Vendor, Service Account, Shared / Generic, System / Batch, Other. |
| Employment Status | Enter the HR status at the extraction date; allowed values: Active, Leave of Absence, Terminated, Transferred, Not in HR, N/A. |
| Company / Legal Entity | Enter the employing company, legal entity, or external vendor organisation associated with the user. |
| Department / Function | Enter the user's department, cost centre, or functional area according to HR or the identity source. |
| Job Title | Enter the user's current job title according to HR or the identity source. |
| Line Manager | Enter the user's current line manager name according to HR or the identity source; for non-human accounts, enter N/A. |
| Account Owner / Sponsor | Enter the business owner or sponsor responsible for the account, mandatory for contractors, vendors, shared accounts, generic accounts, and service accounts. |
| Account Status | Enter the current account status in the system; allowed values: Active, Enabled, Disabled, Locked, Suspended, Expired, Deleted, Unknown. |
| Account Created Date | Enter the date the account was created in the source system in YYYY-MM-DD format, or N/A if not available. |
| Last Login Date | Enter the user's most recent successful login date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or N/A if not available or not applicable. |
| Authentication Type | Enter how the user authenticates; allowed values: SSO, Local Password, MFA, SSH Key, Certificate, API Key, Service Credential, Other, Unknown. |
| Role / Profile / Group Name | Enter the exact role, profile, security group, responsibility, job role, or access package assigned to the user. |
| Entitlement / Permission Name | Enter the specific permission, privilege, transaction code, menu, function, object, responsibility, or access right included in the listing. |
| Access Level | Enter the highest level of access granted by the role or entitlement; allowed values: Read Only, Create, Modify, Approve, Post, Admin, Super User, Developer, Execute, Other. |
| Privileged Access Flag | Enter Yes if the account or entitlement provides administrator, security, configuration, developer, database, root, superuser, or elevated access; otherwise enter No. |
| SOX-Relevant Access Flag | Enter Yes if the access can impact financially relevant data, reports, interfaces, configurations, jobs, or transactions; otherwise enter No. |
| Sensitive / High-Risk Access Flag | Enter Yes if the access is sensitive or high risk, including payment, vendor master, journal posting, user administration, configuration, production change, or reporting access; otherwise enter No. |
| Segregation of Duties Risk Flag | Enter Yes if the access creates or contributes to a known SoD conflict according to the organisation's SoD ruleset; otherwise enter No or Not Assessed. |
| Shared / Generic Account Flag | Enter Yes if the account is used by more than one person or is not attributable to a named individual; otherwise enter No. |
| Service Account Flag | Enter Yes if the account is used for system, integration, batch, automation, or application-to-application purposes; otherwise enter No. |
| Access Granted Date | Enter the date the listed role or entitlement was granted in YYYY-MM-DD format, or N/A if not available. |
| Access Request / Approval Reference | Enter the ticket, workflow, request ID, or approval record supporting the access grant, or N/A if not available. |
| Termination Date | Enter the user's HR termination date in YYYY-MM-DD format if applicable; otherwise enter N/A. |
| Transfer Date | Enter the user's most recent HR transfer or role-change date in YYYY-MM-DD format if applicable; otherwise enter N/A. |
| Reviewer Name | Enter the name of the business or system access reviewer who will assess this user's access during the periodic review; leave blank until assigned if not yet known. |
| Reviewer Decision | Enter the review outcome for the listed access; allowed values: Retain, Remove, Modify, Investigate, Not Reviewed, N/A. |
| Review Exception Reference | Enter the exception, issue, or audit finding reference if inappropriate access or listing completeness issues are identified; otherwise enter N/A. |
| Remediation Required Flag | Enter Yes if the reviewer decision requires access removal, modification, investigation, or other corrective action; otherwise enter No. |
| Remediation Action | Enter the specific action to be taken, e.g. remove role, disable account, update owner, add MFA, document approval; enter N/A if no remediation is required. |
| Remediation Completion Date | Enter the date remediation was completed in YYYY-MM-DD format, or N/A if not completed or not required. |
| Notes | Enter concise supporting comments needed to explain unusual access, unavailable data, compensating controls, or review context; otherwise enter N/A. |

### Maintenance

The template is owned by the IT Security / Identity and Access Management control owner, with business process owners responsible for review decisions. It is refreshed for each SOX access review cycle, at minimum quarterly or per the SOX control frequency, using direct exports from the in-scope production application, identity provider, directory service, or privileged access management system.

### Column Guidance

| Column | What to enter |
|---|---|
| Review Period | Enter the period covered by the access review in format YYYY-Q# or YYYY-MM to YYYY-MM, e.g. 2026-Q1. |
| Review Cycle | Enter the review frequency/cycle; allowed values: Quarterly, Semi-Annual, Annual, Ad Hoc. |
| Application / System Name | Enter the formal name of the SOX in-scope application, database, operating system, or platform being reviewed. |
| Application / System ID | Enter the unique application/system identifier used in the CMDB, application inventory, or GRC tool. |
| SOX In-Scope | Indicate whether the system/access is in SOX scope; allowed values: Yes, No. For this template, expected value is Yes unless documenting a scoped-out item. |
| Access Population Extract Date | Enter the date the access listing was extracted from the source system in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Population Source | Enter the source used to generate the access population, e.g. SAP user listing, Active Directory group export, IAM tool report, database role report, ServiceNow CMDB. |
| User ID | Enter the unique user/account ID exactly as shown in the source system. |
| User Full Name | Enter the user’s full legal or HR-recognised name, or account name for non-human/service accounts. |
| User Email | Enter the user’s business email address; for service accounts enter N/A or the accountable owner mailbox. |
| Employment / Contractor Status | Enter the user status; allowed values: Employee, Contractor, Third Party, Service Account, Shared Account, Terminated, Unknown. |
| Department / Business Unit | Enter the user’s department, cost centre, or business unit from HR/IAM records. |
| Job Title | Enter the user’s current job title or role from HR/IAM records. |
| Manager / Certifier Name | Enter the name of the manager, application owner, or business process owner responsible for certifying whether the access remains appropriate. |
| Manager / Certifier Email | Enter the business email address of the manager/certifier. |
| Access Type | Enter the type of access reviewed; allowed values: Application Role, Security Group, Privileged Role, Database Role, Operating System Group, Service Account, Shared Account, Other. |
| Role / Group / Profile Name | Enter the exact role, group, profile, permission set, or entitlement name assigned to the user. |
| Role / Group Description | Enter a plain-language description of what the role/group/profile permits the user to do. |
| Privileged Access Flag | Indicate whether the access is privileged or administrative; allowed values: Yes, No. |
| Sensitive Access Flag | Indicate whether the access permits financially significant or sensitive transactions/data; allowed values: Yes, No. |
| Segregation of Duties Conflict Flag | Indicate whether the access creates or contributes to a known SoD conflict; allowed values: Yes, No, Not Assessed. |
| Last Login Date | Enter the user’s most recent login date from the source system in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter Never if no login exists or N/A if unavailable. |
| Access Last Modified Date | Enter the date the role/group/profile assignment was last created or changed in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter N/A if unavailable. |
| Business Justification | Enter the business reason supporting continued access, especially for privileged, sensitive, service, or exception access. |
| Reviewer Decision | Enter the certifier’s decision; allowed values: Retain, Remove, Modify, Investigate, Transfer Owner, Not Reviewed. |
| Reviewer Comments | Enter concise comments supporting the reviewer decision, including rationale for retention or details of required change/removal. |
| Exception Required | Indicate whether the review identified an access exception requiring remediation or formal acceptance; allowed values: Yes, No. |
| Exception Type | If Exception Required is Yes, enter the type; allowed values: Inappropriate Access, Excessive Access, Terminated User, Dormant Account, Privileged Access Not Approved, SoD Conflict, Missing Owner, Service Account Issue, Other. Enter N/A if no exception. |
| Remediation Action | Enter the required corrective action, e.g. remove role, disable account, reduce privileges, update owner, document compensating control, or N/A if no exception. |
| Remediation Owner | Enter the person or team responsible for completing the remediation action; enter N/A if no remediation is required. |
| Remediation Due Date | Enter the target completion date for remediation in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter N/A if no remediation is required. |
| Remediation Completion Date | Enter the actual date remediation was completed in YYYY-MM-DD format; enter N/A if not applicable or not yet completed. |
| Remediation Evidence Reference | Enter the ticket number, change request ID, screenshot file name, system log reference, or evidence repository link proving remediation; enter N/A if not applicable. |
| Final Status | Enter the final outcome for the line item; allowed values: Certified, Remediated, Exception Accepted, Pending Remediation, Pending Review, Removed, Modified. |
| Certification Date | Enter the date the manager/certifier completed certification for this line item in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Certification Evidence Reference | Enter the evidence reference for the certification, such as workflow approval ID, signed certification file name, email approval reference, or GRC campaign ID. |
| Prepared By | Enter the name of the person who prepared the review population/log. |
| Prepared Date | Enter the date the review log was prepared in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Reviewed By / Control Owner | Enter the name of the control owner or delegate who reviewed completion and evidence quality. |
| Control Owner Review Date | Enter the date the control owner reviewed and approved the completed access review in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| Audit Notes | Enter any audit-relevant notes, limitations, follow-ups, or cross-references; enter N/A if none. |

### Maintenance

Owned by the ITGC Access Control Owner or IAM Governance lead, with input from application owners and business managers/certifiers. Updated each quarterly review cycle using current access extracts from the authoritative source systems, IAM tool, application reports, HR data, and ticketing/GRC evidence repositories.
